jobs.title: Marketing Manager, Digital Ads ADA Program, Amazon Digital Ads: Direct Access
jobs.excerpt:
Join Amazon's Display Advertising team to build meaningful partnerships with internal business teams while shaping the future of digital marketing. You'll provide strategic guidance on campaign management, technical support, and best practices—directly influencing how Amazon reaches and engages customers across web, mobile, video, and audio formats. Key job responsibilities Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with internal business teams by providing consultative support, technical guidance, and industry best practices to help them achieve their advertising objectives Deliver comprehensive onboarding and ongoing education to ensure teams can effectively use our advertising platform and continuously optimize their campaigns Analyze campaign performance data and provide actionable recommendations to improve results, identifying trends and opportunities across multiple campaigns and business units Serve as the primary technical point of contact for troubleshooting issues, managing support requests, and ensuring timely resolution of platform-related challenges Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather client feedback, identify platform improvements, and help shape the evolution of our tools and processes A day in the life As a Marketing Manager supporting our Display Advertising program, you'll be the trusted advisor for internal business teams navigating our advertising platform. Your day might include conducting training sessions to help teams maximize campaign performance, analyzing real-time campaign data to identify optimization opportunities, and collaborating with product and engineering teams to refine our tools based on client feedback. You'll troubleshoot technical challenges, mentor teams on industry best practices, and work across time zones to support global business initiatives. Beyond routine support, you'll contribute to defining how we evolve our platform by synthesizing patterns from client interactions and translating them into actionable recommendations for our product and technology teams. About the team We're building solutions that enable Amazon's digital marketing vision—helping internal teams effectively reach their audiences while contributing to Amazon's broader advertising ecosystem. Our team combines marketing expertise with data-driven decision-making to develop and scale programs that drive customer acquisition and lifetime value. We work collaboratively across Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, and Finance to create tools and processes that make digital advertising more accessible and impactful. You'll join a results-oriented group committed to pushing the boundaries of digital formats and delivering exceptional service to the teams we support.

Basic qualifications:
- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience - Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements - Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables) - Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns - Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams

Preferred qualifications:

jobs.title: ISV Marketing Manager , NAMER Strategic Customer and Partner Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a results-driven ISV Marketing Manager to design and execute high-impact ABM and partner marketing programs for enterprise software customers within a designated field territory. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive measurable business outcomes through targeted customer and partner marketing initiatives. The ISV Marketing Manager will own the end-to-end execution of territory ABM and partner programs, working backwards from ISV needs to create data-driven, multi-channel campaigns that accelerate pipeline and revenue growth. This role requires strong project management, partner marketing skills, analytical capabilities, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders. Key job responsibilities Key Responsibilities: • Design and execute territory-specific ABM campaigns (1:1, 1:few) that align with global frameworks and drive measurable business impact • Develop ISV Marketing Account Plans • Build and maintain strong relationships with sales teams to understand account priorities and translate them into effective marketing programs • Analyze customer data, buying signals, and market trends to inform campaign strategy and optimization • Create and implement multi-channel programs (events, digital, direct) that deliver personalized customer experiences • Partner with regional marketing teams to ensure ABM and partner marketing programs complement broader global marketing efforts • Drive operational excellence through standardized processes, documentation, and best practices • Track and report on program performance, using data to optimize and scale successful approaches • Manage program budgets effectively, demonstrating frugality while maximizing impact • Collaborate with global ABM and partner marketing community to share learnings and adopt proven practices A day in the life Success Measures: • Pipeline influence and revenue contribution from ISV accounts • Account engagement metrics and program ROI • Sales team satisfaction scores • Program execution quality and timeliness • Process improvement and best practice contributions About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. jobs.title: Outbound Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.excerpt:
🚀 Join HubSpot as an Outbound Business Development Representative (BDR)  📍 Remote (USA) or Cambridge, MA, USA 
 We’ll be honest — sales isn’t easy, and it’s not for everyone. But for those who love a challenge, thrive on results, and want to launch a long-term path in sales, it’s incredibly rewarding . 
 If you’re looking to “try out” sales or just dip a toe in, this probably isn’t the role for you. But, if you’re the kind of person who wakes up hungry to compete, thrives on setting and smashing goals, and wants to build a career in tech sales from the ground up — we want to talk to you. 
 At HubSpot, our BDRs are not only the first point of contact for our prospects—they’re also developing the skills and mindset to become our next generation of Account Executives. This is not a placeholder job — it’s the first chapter of a high-growth sales career designed for those who want to build skills, embrace feedback, move fast, and grow even faster. 
 The Role: As an Outbound BDR , you’ll play a key role in HubSpot’s growth engine. You'll be the first touchpoint for many of our future customers, sparking conversations through strategic outreach, uncovering pain points, and qualifying leads. You’ll partner closely with Account Executives to deliver high-quality meetings that drive pipeline, impact, and revenue. Along the way, you’ll sharpen your sales toolkit daily and gain exposure to a world-class sales organization. 
 Compensation & Career Track: This is the first of three levels in our BDR program — designed to take you from prospecting pro to promoting to a full-cycle closer. 💰 Base salary: $53,800 annually 📈 On-target commission: $23,000 annually 🎯 OTE (on-target earnings): $76,800 annually With each promotion, both salary and commission increase — along with your impact. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Own and execute outbound prospecting through high-volume outreach (60–100+ activities/day) via phone, email, and LinkedIn. 
 Collaborate with Account Executives to target strategic accounts and refine outreach strategy. 
 Qualify leads based on fit, need, and urgency — and book quality discovery meetings. 
 Hit (and exceed) KPIs for activity, meetings delivered, and pipeline impact. 
 Grow fast. Learn fast. Get coached. Apply it. Repeat. 
 
 What You Won’t Do: 
 
 Coast. We move fast, we test, we iterate, and we compete. 
 Wait for someone to tell you what to do. We value self-starters who take ownership. 
 Treat this as “just a job.” This is a foundational role, setting you up for a successful long term career in sales. 
 
 We’re Looking For People Who: 
 ✅ Have 0-2 years of professional sales experience, excluding projects, internships, coursework, bootcamps  ✅ Are eager to grow long-term within a sales path–if your focus is split between sales and other paths like customer success, marketing, operations, etc, this role likely won’t be the best fit. ✅ Are resilient, coachable, and crave feedback to improve. ✅ Are curious and ask why, not just how. ✅ Set high standards for themselves — and hit them. ✅ Are technologically fluent, adapting to new technologies and leveraging AI in your day-to-day. ✅ Communicate clearly, write thoughtfully, and can confidently conduct a cold call. ✅ Are energized by a fast-paced environment and a bit of friendly competition. ✅ Either have past sales success or have demonstrated excellence in goal-driven roles (think: fundraising, athletics, service industry, etc). 
   
 Tools We Use (and You’ll Learn): 
 
 HubSpot (of course)! 
 LinkedIn Sales Navigator 
 AI Powered Tools across all aspects of the role for research & outreach 
 Slack, Zoom, LeadIQ, Google Suite, Zoominfo, and more 
 
 To Apply: 📝 No cover letter required. 📄 Submit your resume. 👉 If you're new to sales, show us your grit: include examples of how you've hit ambitious goals in other roles. 📊 If you’ve been in sales before, highlight metrics like quota attainment. 
 Please Review: Important Information about the Program 
 Bottom Line: We’re looking for future stars, not just seat-fillers. If you want to grow into an elite sales professional and are ready to work hard, get uncomfortable, and see what you're really capable of — this is your shot. 
 Pay & Benefits 
 The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons. 
 This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy . 
 Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better. 
 At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community. Annual Cash Compensation Range: $53,800 — $90,000 USD 
 At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections. 
 If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements 
 
 About HubSpot 
 HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.  
 At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow. 
 We’re building a company where people can do their best work . We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too. 
 Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world. 
 Explore more: 
 
 HubSpot Careers

jobs.title: Enterprise Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. 
 The Enterprise segment is seeking a new Business Development Representative (BDR) to help generate a quality pipeline for our Account Executives focused on our Regional Mid-Market business segment. You will help build the pipeline by strategically prospecting and nurturing opportunities in accounts with 16-40 locations.  This role is a great opportunity to develop outbound and phone skills by delivering a consultative platform pitch to C-suite, VP, and Director level positions across departments like IT, Operations, Accounting/Finance & Marketing. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast paced team with varied future customers and personalized training and career opportunities. 
 You will gain exposure to the Enterprise sales process and work cross-functionally with many segments of our team including Senior Management, Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, Services & Support, etc.  You will also work closely with seasoned Account Executives to develop targeted prospecting strategies in their assigned markets. 
 A day in the life (Responsibilities)   
 
 Generate new business pipeline primarily through outbound prospecting (3+ new business qualified sales opportunities per month + 7 meetings monthly) 
 Gain interest through outbound cold calling across a set of accounts/prospects and breaking into net new logos in assigned territory (65+ activities per day) 
 Schedule discovery calls, demos, on-sites and follow-up calls (owning the process until calls or meetings occur) 
 Leverage existing tools and research to find new contacts to develop your call-base 
 Focused efforts promoting new products to prospects 
 Multi-threading and account mapping within large restaurant brands corporate teams and franchisees  
 Persistent, organized follow-up with nurture contacts/accounts to re-engage on a next step (bring them back to the table!) 
 Entering activity, notes, company account info and updating opportunities in Salesforce 
 Work effectively with assigned AEs on a daily/weekly/monthly basis on maintaining target account lists and prospecting strategies 
 Provide input in the design of & help in the execution of enterprise marketing efforts (campaigns, trade-shows, etc) 
 
 What you'll need to thrive (Requirements): 
 
 Software/SaaS experience or other related tech space business experience in an outbound or closing role 
 Previous outbound and inbound sales experience 
 Fearless on the phone and persistent in initial reach out & follow-up with accounts over time  
 Ability to identify key decision makers within new accounts, while aligning with internal account reps 
 Well organized, self-motivated to make calls everyday and communicate effectively with internal teams and prospects in a productive manner 
 Adaptable to new processes and ability to work cross-functionally and develop relationships with both internal and external stakeholders  
 High customer empathy and the ability to handle objections 
 Attention to detail and ability to thrive in a changing and evolving environment 
 Demonstrate verbal and written skill sets in communication 
 
 Special Skills (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves): 
 
 Restaurant experience  
 MEDDPICC certified 
 Command of the Message 
 Experience using Nooks, Salesforce, Zoominfo, LeadIQ, Claude/Gemini, Linkedin Sales Navigator  
 
 AI at Toast

jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 Growth Marketing is a team of performance-driven marketers and channel specialists. We partner closely with growth product, regional and demand marketing, and sales to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. We work globally, on the full customer lifecycle, and with all company segments - from startups to the largest enterprises. This role is focused on driving growth for Stripe Capital. 
 Stripe Capital provides access to fast, flexible financing to businesses, with the mission of helping them accelerate their growth. Businesses use the funds for marketing, hiring, geographic expansion, working capital, new equipment purchases, and much more. Capital has scaled meaningfully over the last few years, both in terms of user impact (over 81,000 businesses received financing through Stripe Capital in 2025 alone) as well as financial impact as a business line within Stripe. Over 95% of our users say they love using Capital, making us one of the most popular products at Stripe—and we're just getting started. 
 What you’ll do 
 As a Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you will be a key driver of global marketing efforts supporting our self-serve user acquisition motions to drive demand and revenue growth for Capital — designing, implementing, and optimizing scaled, global lifecycle campaigns across user segments and life stages. You will help create uncommonly great email marketing campaigns and multi-channel experiences for Capital through a relentless focus on user experience and channel optimization. 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Drive ideation, strategy, and execution of scaled lifecycle campaigns across email and in-product notifications to drive core business outcomes (e.g. new user acquisition, product activation, revenue), and test into and scale new channels (direct mail, push notifications, etc)  
 Identify customer needs, ideate solutions to improve user experience, and generate ongoing user-driven insights to inform campaign strategy and optimization 
 Leverage marketing automation, behavioral data, and ML-based techniques to create personalized experiences at scale 
 Analyze trends, develop actionable insights to optimize against targets, and socialize relevant learnings across the organization 
 Collaborate closely with key stakeholders across Growth, Product, Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, Sales, and Marketing 
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 7+ years of work experience in a marketing role designing and launching multi-channel campaigns 
 5+ years of experience analyzing and taking action on the performance of marketing campaigns 
 5+ years of experience writing marketing briefs 
 3+ years of experience leveraging data, AI, and ML-driven techniques 
 3+ years of B2B marketing experience 
 3+ years of email marketing, direct mail, and push notification experience 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience with Marketo, Salesforce, and/or Salesloft 
 Experience working in fintech on lending products

jobs.title: Americas Field Marketing, AI
jobs.excerpt:
About Stripe 
 Stripe's infrastructure and suite of APIs powers hundreds of thousands of businesses—from startups to Fortune 500s—in almost every country around the world. From developers and product managers to founders and CFOs, a broad audience interacts with Stripe's products and uses them to start, run, and scale their companies. Removing the barriers to online commerce helps more new businesses get started, expedites growth for existing companies, and increases economic output and trade globally. 
 We operate at a significant scale, but we're still tiny relative to the opportunity ahead, so there is still much to do. Join us and help put the global economy within everyone's reach. 
 Role Overview 
 We're seeking an experienced, creative, and results-oriented marketer who knows the AI ecosystem to drive world-class field marketing for AI organizations in the Americas region. This field marketer will be responsible for executing marketing strategies that delivers growth and revenue at scale for AI businesses. The ideal candidate is data-driven, relentlessly seeks to optimize, stays at the cutting edge of modern marketing practices, and has a passion for collaborating with sales teams to drive successful customer outcomes. As a member of the Americas Marketing team, this is a great opportunity to build and have a significant impact on our rapidly growing business. 
   
 About the Team  
 The Americas Marketing team is a high-performing group laser-focused on fueling Stripe's expansion across the region. You'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact by building and optimizing programs and strategies. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners in Sales, Product, Partnerships, and others to drive measurable business results and growth. 
   
 You will: 
 
 Execute the regional field marketing strategy and plan to fuel pipeline growth with the AI sales teams across the Americas 
 Monitor key business and revenue metrics, providing cross-functional insights to drive continuous optimization and improvement 
 Partner closely with Demand Generation, Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams to develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns 
 Develop and implement an events strategy, including third-party and Stripe-hosted events (in-person, virtual, and hybrid) that will deliver results for the AI segment 
 Design and execute mid- and lower-funnel Account Based Marketing programs to accelerate leads, opportunities, and revenue growth 
 Develop a focus on acquiring contacts in AI organizations by creating compelling plans, offers and approaches to effectively engage this cohort 
 Leverage Stripe's marketing tech stack and analytics capabilities to drive data-driven decision-making and optimize the field marketing engine 
 
 We’re looking for someone with: 
 
 3-5 years of relevant B2B field marketing experience, executing regional strategies including Account Based Marketing 
 Proven track record of executing marketing programs and events that drive new customer acquisition and pipeline growth 
 Expertise in developing and executing scaled and targeted multi-channel marketing campaigns across the full funnel 
 Experience working in both digital and in-person event environments, with a deep understanding of how to integrate event experiences into the buyer's journey 
 Successful track record of collaborating with Sales teams, including joint planning, lead management, and earning trust as a strategic partner 
 Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills with ability to synthesize and communicate business health with leadership 
 Excellent communication, collaboration, and project management capabilities 
 Startup mentality with a bias for action and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

jobs.excerpt:
AWS Marketing is seeking a motivated Email Marketing Specialist, Nurture to support email campaign execution for our demand generation and product-led growth portfolio. This role is responsible for executing global email marketing initiatives focused on accelerating pipeline progression through audience segmentation, lifecycle journey builds, and ongoing optimization support. Key job responsibilities • Execute email campaigns for assigned nurture programs, including audience list pulls, journey builds, and A/B test setup • Build and deploy multi-touch nurture campaigns that drive prospect engagement and pipeline progression • Monitor and optimize nurture campaigns to improve engagement, conversion rates, and pipeline velocity based on established playbooks and manager guidance • Track and report on email campaign performance, including engagement metrics, funnel progression, and contribution to program goals • Prepare regular campaign performance summaries and surface optimization opportunities to peers and managers • Support decisions on nurture cadence, content sequencing, and suppression/targeting logic by gathering data and preparing recommendations • Develop technical and creative briefs for nurture campaigns in partnership with IDC core teams, marketing operations, and creative teams • Coordinate with stakeholders across core campaign teams, marketing operations, localization, and creative teams to keep campaigns on track Follow team processes and contribute to documentation of email best practices A day in the life You'll start your mornings pulling campaign performance reports and flagging what's working and what needs attention. Midday often means building or QA-ing email journeys — setting up suppression rules, checking audience segments, or launching an A/B test. Afternoons might involve preparing a performance readout for your manager, coordinating with a creative team on an upcoming build, or updating campaign tracking documents. Some weeks are heavy on hands-on campaign execution; others involve more reporting and coordination. You'll learn quickly by doing — and you'll have experienced teammates and a supportive manager to help you grow. About the team We're a global email marketing team focused on helping cloud customers discover the right solutions at the right time. We design and optimize nurture programs that guide prospects through their decision-making journey — from early awareness to active evaluation. You'll work alongside experienced email strategists, marketing partners, and content creators who care deeply about the customer experience. We test constantly, share learnings openly, and invest in developing our team members. If you like getting hands-on with campaigns, learning from data, and seeing the direct impact of your work on how customers engage, you'll feel at home here.

jobs.title: GTM Product Marketing Manager, Commerce Experiences
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team 
 The GTM Product Marketing team sits within Stripe's Product Marketing org. We make sure Stripe sellers walk into every conversation prepared, confident, and armed with the right story. As Stripe's center of excellence for general product enablement, we set the standard for how sellers learn and pitch our products, drive consistency across product suites, and act as Marketing's Voice of the Field — surfacing seller insights to sharpen upstream messaging and positioning. We translate product value into seller-ready narratives, resources, and enablement — and we measure our impact on seller confidence and how effectively our teams pitch, qualify, and close. 
 Stripe's Commerce Experiences products (Optimized Checkout Suite, Link, Terminal, Agentic Commerce) help businesses convert more customers across every channel — from online checkout, to digital wallets, to in-person commerce, to the emerging world of AI-driven shopping. We're looking for an exceptional GTM product marketer to bring Stripe's story to market. In this role, you'll be the connective tissue between product, marketing, and the field. You'll translate complex commerce and checkout capabilities into compelling narratives and seller resources that resonate with our users and drive adoption. You'll equip customer-facing teams to confidently pitch all our solutions, answer technical questions, and speak to the roadmap. You'll also elevate seller and field insights to refine product positioning and messaging. 
 What you’ll do 
 As the GTM PMM for Commerce Experiences, you’ll need to quickly build a deep understanding of Stripe’s Commerce Experiences products, buyer personas, and differentiation. You will: 
 
 Own the content development and GTM enablement strategy across the sold funnel — creating seller-ready resources (pitch decks, FAQs, value props, talking points) that translate product positioning into clear, differentiated customer value propositions for enterprise, mid-market, and platform buyers. 
 Partner with Market Intelligence to monitor and understand commerce, checkout, and emerging agentic commerce market trends, competitive dynamics, and seller-facing competitive narratives — synthesize insights, and leverage these to build differentiated positioning. 
 Design and deliver training programs that build seller expertise across the Commerce Experiences portfolio. 
 Prepare sellers for major product launch events like Stripe Sessions, and to understand the details of the roadmap product is building. 
 Leverage data and insights to identify enablement and knowledge gaps, prioritize asset development, launch new content, and measure effectiveness on seller confidence and other KPIs. 
 Surface field insights on a regular cadence — through monthly readouts and structured retros — to inform core PMM positioning and product roadmap. 
 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 3+ years of product marketing experience, preferably in B2B tech. 
 Direct experience with checkout, ecommerce, digital wallets, agentic commerce or other commerce platforms is strongly preferred.  
 Experience with Enterprise sales cycles and technical products. 
 Excellent communication and presentation abilities, with a proven track record of distilling complex strategies into clear, compelling narratives. 
 Strong stakeholder management skills. 
 Ability to move quickly without compromising attention to detail or polish. 
 A self-starter who thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and can manage multiple priorities simultaneously. 
 Comfort with data-driven decision making and measuring marketing impact. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing, and contribute to alignment on shared goals. 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Demonstrated comfort working with, and presenting to, senior leaders across a variety of disciplines. 
 Strong collaboration skills, a tendency to seek and share alternative views, and an ability to earn stakeholder confidence  
 Experience using or building AI-powered tooling to accelerate seller productivity or content development.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Competitive Intelligence
jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About the Role 
 Looking for a role where you can build something from scratch instead of inheriting someone else's playbook? We're hiring our first Competitive Intelligence Manager to own the competitive program end to end. You'll keep our field teams sharp with real-time intel, run sales enablement that reps actually use, feed competitive signals into product and roadmap decisions, and shape campaigns that make it obvious why we win. 
 As our Competitive Intelligence Lead, you'll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and Product Management to keep us ahead of the market. If you like owning a function nobody's built yet, turning scattered competitor noise into a clear point of view, and being the person sales calls before a big deal, this is your role. 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Create and define differentiating positioning for our products and solutions for our various personas (ex: marketing teams, product teams, data teams etc) 
 Run point on cross-functional launches and campaigns across marketing, sales, and product 
 Conduct user research to identify gaps in the market for our product to fill 
 Create, maintain, and improve website messaging, customer case studies, and sales enablement materials 
 Help internal teams and product evangelists craft messaging and sequences that align with customer value 
 Externally evangelize Hightouch at field events, customer engagements, and webinars 
 
 What We’re Looking For 
 
 4-6 years in competitive intelligence, product marketing, or market research, ideally in B2B SaaS 
 Strong primary and secondary research skills (win/loss interviews, analyst reports, public filings, review sites, pricing pages); ability to synthesize messy, conflicting signals into a clear point of view; comfortable building and maintaining structured frameworks (battlecards, comparison matrices, positioning maps). 
 Proven track record of producing content that sales and marketing actually use — battlecards, competitive decks, objection handling guides 
 Storytelling: Proficient in turning complex, technology-heavy topics into digestible, compelling stories that resonate with target audiences 
 Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a talent for crafting clear, persuasive messaging 
 Cross-functional fluency: has worked closely with sales (win/loss, deal support), product (roadmap and positioning input), and marketing (messaging, launches); understands sales cycles well enough to know what reps need in the moment, not just what's "interesting." 
 Domain fit: familiarity with data infrastructure, CDPs, MarTech, or adjacent technical B2B markets. 
 High ownership: flags competitive shifts before sales asks, not just after losing a deal; comfortable being the first person to build this function rather than inheriting an existing playbook. 
 
 Bonus If You Have 
 
 Built or owned a CI program (not just contributed to one) at a prior company; experience in a high-growth or fast-moving market where competitors and positioning shift often. 
 Experience in the CDP, martech, data infrastructure, adtech, AI, or lifecycle marketing ecosystem 
 Startup Experience: Previous experience working in a startup environment, demonstrating the ability to adapt quickly and thrive in a fast-paced setting while wearing many hats. 
 
 The salary range for this position is $135,000 - $165,000 USD per year, which is location-independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options and offer early exercise and a 10-year post-termination exercise window. E-Verify Statement 
 Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

jobs.title: Partner Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
Who we are  
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. 
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . 
 Hiring and how we work 
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!  
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  . See yourself at Twilio 
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Marketing Manager. 
 About the job 
 This position is needed to help scale our partner ecosystem and drive pipeline growth. In this role you will build, execute, and measure co-marketing campaigns. 
 This is the perfect role for a marketer with 4–6 years of experience who understands the fundamentals of B2B marketing and channel dynamics, and is ready to take full ownership of partner-facing initiatives. If you are a strong project manager, a collaborative relationship-builder, and data-driven, you will thrive in this role. 
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 
 Co-Marketing & Campaign Development 
 
 Full-Funnel Campaign Development: Work collaboratively to create  campaigns that touch all stages of the buyer’s journey, from awareness to conversion, including joint webinars, customer events, co-created content, etc.. 
 Email Nurture Programs: Design, build, and optimize post-event and post-campaign email nurture programs to execute a comprehensive, multi-touch engagement strategy. 
 Customer Success Stories: Co-author customer success stories featuring strategic partners for both external marketing promotion and internal sales enablement. 
 Tri-Party Plays: Support the development of bundled technology playbooks and build robust, market-ready use cases. 

 Partner Comms Support 
 
 Joint PR and Thought Leadership: Help define and implement joint PR, whitepapers, and thought leadership pieces to elevate our shared brand presence. 
 Own and manage the Twilio Partner Social Media Strategy in alignment with Twilio Corporate plans 

 Partner Campaign & Program Coordination and Management 
 
 Partner-Led Events: Support the execution of partner-hosted campaigns: webinars, regional field events with partners, and customer workshops, including content alignment. 
 Industry Conference Program Support: Assist in coordinating our co-presence with partners at major industry trade shows, managing joint booth presence, logistics, and ancillary partner networking events with customers. 

 Qualifications  
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! 
 *Required: 
 
 Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in Partner Marketing, Channel Marketing, or B2B Demand Generation within the B2B tech/SaaS space. 
 Marketing Fundamentals: Solid understanding of multi-channel demand generation, event execution, and content marketing. 
 Tool Stack: Hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo) is highly preferred. 
 Budgeting Skills: Experience managing or assisting with MDF (Market Development Funds) and budget tracking. 
 Project Management: Exceptional organizational skills with a proven ability to juggle multiple campaigns, events, and partner deadlines simultaneously. 
 Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently collaborate with external partner stakeholders. 
 
 Location 
 This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA. 
 Travel  
 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. 
 What We Offer 
 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. 
 Compensation 
 *Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only. 
 The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows: 
 
 Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $96,640 - $120,800. 
 Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $102,240 - $127,800. 
 Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $113,600 - $142,000. 
 This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. 
 
 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. 
 Application deadline information  
 Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until October 31, 2026, but may change based on business needs.  Twilio thinks big. Do you? 
 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts. 
 So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions. 
 . 
 Stay alert to recruitment fraud

jobs.title: Analyst, GTM Analytics
jobs.excerpt:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. 
 About the Role 
 Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies. 
 We’re looking for a an Analyst to join our GTM Analytics team, where we turn data into the insights that shape decisions across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, and more. Most of your work will be answering business questions directly — pulling and structuring data, summarizing it clearly, and delivering a recommendation. When a request genuinely calls for a dashboard, you'll help scope the requirements and hand them off to our central data team to build. 
 In this role, you'll work on well-scoped, clearly framed requests — writing SQL to pull data, looking up how a metric is already built in Looker or Omni when one exists, using Claude to refine and debug your queries, and shaping the output in Excel or Google Sheets into something a stakeholder can act on. This is a developmental role: as you build experience, you'll take on progressively more ambiguous and higher-stakes requests. 
 This is a full-time position based out of our Costa Rica office. 
 Technologies You’ll Use 
 SQL, Excel and/or Google Sheets (pivot tables, lookups, formulas), Claude (or similar AI assistants), Salesforce (viewing/reading data) — exposure to BI tools like Looker, Omni, Sigma, or Hex is a plus 
 What You’ll Do 
 
 Write and adapt SQL queries against well-defined requests, using Claude to refine logic and troubleshoot errors 
 Look up existing metrics in Looker or Omni to understand how they're already built, and reuse that logic where it applies 
 Pull, clean, and structure data in Excel or Google Sheets to answer scoped stakeholder questions 
 Summarize findings into clear, plain-language takeaways for non-technical stakeholders 
 Validate data accuracy against source systems before sharing outputs 
 Ask clarifying questions to properly scope a request before starting work 
 Escalate requests that require deeper analytical judgment to senior team members 
 Maintain documentation of recurring requests and their underlying logic 
 Support ad hoc reporting needs across Sales, Strategy, RevOps, Marketing, Deal Desk, among others 
 Build working knowledge of dbt Labs' GTM data model (Salesforce objects, opportunity stages, fiscal calendar) 
 
 Skills We’re Looking For 
 
 Working knowledge of SQL (SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, basic aggregate functions) 
 Comfortable using AI tools like Claude to write, debug, or refine queries and analysis 
 Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, formulas) 
 Clear written and verbal communication skills in English 
 Basic understanding of SaaS sales concepts (opportunity stages, pipeline) 
 Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work 
 Comfortable asking questions rather than guessing at ambiguous requests 
 Comfortable navigating existing Looker or Omni dashboards to trace how a metric is defined and built 
 
 Bonus Skills​ 
 
 Experience building in BI or exploratory-analysis tools like Looker, Omni, Sigma, or Hex (not required — happy to teach this on the job) 
 Familiarity with Salesforce 
 Prior internship or role in analytics, RevOps, or FP&A 
 Basic Python 
 
 #LI-MM1 #LI-Remote   
 Perks and Benefits 
 
 100% employer-paid medical insurance * 
 Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 
 RSU stock grants* 
 Professional development and training opportunities 
 Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities 
 Monthly cell phone stipend 
 Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 
 
 * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information 
 Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 
 
 We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our  core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in  Forbes .      
 Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. 
 To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. 
 To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . 
 
 We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

Who we are  
 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. 
 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . 
 Hiring and how we work 
 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!  
 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  . See yourself at Twilio 
 Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Marketing Specialist. 
 About the job 
 This position is needed to support the operational, logistical, and marketing enablement backbone of our partner marketing ecosystem. In this role, you will be the engine behind our partner programs, ensuring that lead data is processed accurately, marketing budgets are meticulously tracked, key events run flawlessly, and partners have the ready-to-use campaign materials they need to succeed. 
 This is an ideal role for someone with 3–4 years of marketing experience who loves data management, systems (like Salesforce and Tableau), event coordination, and supporting scalable marketing programs. If you are a proactive problem solver who thrives on keeping projects on track, assets organized, and data clean, we want you on our team. 
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 
 Data Operations Support 
 
 Lead Management: Own the end-to-end lead upload process for all partner-related campaigns and events, ensuring clean data formatting, proper tagging, and accurate partner attribution. 
 Data Hygiene: Routinely audit campaign member statuses and partner accounts to ensure data accuracy for executive leadership reporting. 

 Content and Asset Coordination 
 
 Toolkit Packaging: Coordinate the assembly, packaging, and distribution of global "campaign-in-a-box" kits that partners can easily execute independently. 
 Portal Management: Keep the self-service Partner Portal organized and up-to-date, ensuring assets are easily discoverable by our partner network. 
 Asset Support: Assist in reviewing partner-submitted, co-branded materials to ensure alignment with brand guidelines before they are published. 

 Event Logistics Support 
 
 Partner Summit/Events Support: Serve as a core coordinator for our annual Partner Summit/PABs etc., managing project timelines, registration tracking, vendor communications, and on-site or virtual logistics. 

 Budget Tracking and Support: 
 
 Financial Administration: Support the global partner marketing budget processes, ensuring all purchase orders (POs) and vendor invoices are submitted, processed, and logged correctly. 

 Qualifications  
 Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! 
 *Required: 
 
 Experience: 3–4 years of experience in Marketing Operations, Event Coordination, or Partner/Channel Marketing support roles. 
 Technical Aptitude: Hands-on experience with Salesforce (SFDC) ; familiarity with Tableau (or similar BI tools) for building basic reports is highly desirable. 
 Excel/Data Skills: Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel/Google Sheets) for formatting partner lead lists and tracking budgets. 
 Asset & Content Delivery: Experience organizing digital assets, managing shared drives, or updating a Partner Relationship Management (PRM) platform/CMS portal. 
 Event Logistics: Proven experience helping plan and execute corporate events, webinars, or large-scale internal/external meetings. 
 Organization: Exceptional attention to detail and project management skills—you are someone who gets energized by checklists, deadlines, and tidy data. 
 
 Location 
 This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA. 
 Travel  
 We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings. 
 What We Offer 
 Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. 
 Compensation 
 *Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only. 
 The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

 This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave. 
 
 The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

 Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until October 31, 2026, but may change based on business needs.  Twilio thinks big. Do you? 
 We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic . Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

jobs.excerpt:
Our Mission: 
 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency.  We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. 
 Our People: 
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.  As our Partner Marketing Manager you will be responsible for turning strategic partnerships into a measurable pipeline motion- building the co-marketing programs, and partner activation strategies that help communicate the power of 6Sense alongside our key partners. This is a builder's role for someone who wants to own a meaningful piece of how 6sense grows, and who understands that great partner marketing sits at the intersection of relationship depth and disciplined execution.   
 Responsibilities :   
 
 Joint Go-to-Market Programs Build and run co-marketing programs with strategic partners ,  from end to end: partner alignment, asset development, campaign execution, field activation, and measurement. Own the pipeline contribution from partner marketing activity and be accountable for reporting it clearly.   
 Joint Events and Activations Own the partner presence at key industry events (including our own,  BreakThrough ), co-hosted webinars, and joint field programs. Coordinate  logistics , messaging, and follow-up across both sides of the partnership to make sure activations generate  pipeline .   
 Partner Relationships Serve as the primary marketing counterpart to partner marketing and alliances teams at key accounts. Build the kind of working relationships where partner counterparts are actively seeking  us out. Create  opportunities  for 6sense to  co-present at joint  events, and  develop the trust that makes joint programs move faster.   
 Partner Marketing Metrics Define what success looks like for partner marketing at 6sense,  working with marketing operations to  build the reporting infrastructure to measure it, and communicate results to marketing leadership and BD stakeholders on a regul ar  cade nce .   
 Performance Measurement   
 Partner-Sourced Pipeline Volume and velocity of pipeline generated through co-marketing programs and partner activations, tracked with clear attribution.   
 Partner Marketing Engagement Depth of engagement from partner counterparts: co-investment in programs, co-branded content produced, joint events executed, and partner-sourced leads generated.   
 Enablement Adoption Usage and effectiveness of partner-facing enablement materials, measured by partner sales team feedback and co-sell conversation rates.   
 Program Execution Quality On-time, on-brief delivery of co-marketing programs - with the partner relationship strengthened as a result.   
 
 Competencies and Behaviors:   
 
 Influence Without Authority  Operates effectively in an environment where the people you most depend on (partner counterparts, internal sales, product marketing) don't report into the same leadership. Builds alignment through credibility and relationships.   
 Revenue-First Thinking  Connects every program to pipeline and revenue. Doesn't measure success by content produced or events run. Asks "what did this produce?" and builds programs that are designed to answer that question.   
 Partner-Facing Presence  Comfortable representing 6sense externally. Shows up in partner conversations with enough confidence and preparation to be a genuine asset in the room.   
 Execution Discipline  Manages the complexity of co-marketing at pace. Gets joint programs across the finish line even when approval chains are complex.   
 Cross-Functional Orchestration Works fluidly across product marketing, demand generation, content, field marketing, and BD to bring partner programs to life. 
 
 Educational and Experience Requirements: 
 
 5 or more years in B2B marketing, with at least 2 years in a field marketing role, partner marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing role where you owned outcomes and field programs.   
 Experience working directly with external partner stakeholders. You have presented to partner leadership, negotiated co-marketing agreements, and maintained productive relationships through disagreements.   
 A clear point of view on how to measure partner marketing impact, including how to handle the attribution ambiguity that comes with the territory.   
 Familiarity with the B2B SaaS technology ecosystem: how ISV partnerships, technology integrations, and co-sell motions work in practice.

jobs.excerpt:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast. The GTM Delivery Manager is a key member of the Customer Integrations and Implementation team, responsible for assisting customers with the technical implementation of ZoomInfo’s customer-facing solutions. 
 This is a high-visibility role within an exciting area of the business, with the opportunity to gain domain expertise across all aspects of sales, talent, and marketing intelligence technologies and applications. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Advanced Technical Expertise 
 
 Lead complex, enterprise-level implementations as a senior member of the ZoomInfo Integration and Implementation Team, providing expert guidance and strategic support to high-value clients during the deployment of ZoomInfo product solutions within their internal systems. 
 Maintain expert-level understanding of application integrations within CRM/MAT environments, including Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot, Eloqua, Microsoft Dynamics, ZoomInfo platform, and emerging solutions. 
 
 Client Engagement & Consultation 
 
 Engage in strategic dialogue with C-level executives, IT leaders, and technical stakeholders to customize ZoomInfo Integration implementations that align with enterprise business objectives and technical roadmaps. 
 Provide consultative guidance on best practices, optimization strategies, and scalability considerations for long-term success. 
 
 Advanced Problem Resolution 
 
 Deploy expert-level troubleshooting and diagnostic skills to resolve complex technical issues across integrations and platform solutions. 
 Conduct a root cause analysis for systemic issues and develop preventive measures to enhance overall solution stability. 
 Identify, document, and escalate product defects and enhancement opportunities to Product Development and Engineering teams, providing detailed technical specifications and business impact assessments. 
 
 Cross-Functional Leadership & Mentorship 
 
 Train, mentor, and coach Level One and Two Implementation Managers to foster the development of technical skills and the adoption of best practices. 
 Collaborate with and provide technical leadership to Sales, Client Support, QA Engineering, and Product Management departments on complex client scenarios. 
 
 Technical Thought Leadership 
 
 Conduct high-level technical discussions on advanced topics, including email protocols, OAuth/SSO setup, data transformations, CRM workflows, automation frameworks, API, and enterprise process design with both internal and external stakeholders. 
 Serve as a subject-matter expert on emerging technologies and integration patterns. 
 
 Innovation & Continuous Improvement 
 
 Perform a wide range of complex professional tasks that require exceptional creativity, strategic thinking, and technical innovation. 
 Proactively identify opportunities to enhance implementation processes, tools, and client experiences. 
 Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive solutions to maintain ZoomInfo's technical leadership position. 
 
 What You Will Bring: 
 Advanced Technical Expertise & Certifications 
 
 2+ years of hands-on experience with technical CRM, Marketing Automation implementation, and/or Sales Acceleration platforms in enterprise environments. 
 Advanced certifications in Salesforce (Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Platform App Builder), Marketo Certified Expert, HubSpot Solutions Architect, Eloqua Master, and/or Microsoft Dynamics certifications are strongly preferred but not required. 
 Deep technical proficiency across multiple platforms with demonstrated ability to architect complex, multi-system integrations. 
 
 Strategic Client Partnership & Leadership 
 
 Proven track record of managing high-value, enterprise-level client relationships with exceptional customer service and consultative skills. 
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts accurately, with empathy and clarity, to diverse audiences, including C-suite executives, IT leaders, and end users. 
 Experience leading client workshops and technical discovery sessions 
 Demonstrated ability to build trust and credibility as a strategic technical advisor. 
 
 Expert Problem-Solving & Technical Acumen 
 
 Exceptional capacity to quickly master complex technical infrastructure, emerging technologies, and advanced troubleshooting methodologies. 
 Proven expertise in root cause analysis, systems thinking, and the development of innovative solutions to novel technical challenges. 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to research, diagnose, and resolve sophisticated integration issues independently. 
 
 Leadership & Mentorship 
 
 Demonstrate experience mentoring and developing junior team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. 
 Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives and driving organizational improvements. 
 Ability to influence without authority and build consensus across technical and business stakeholders. 
 
 Collaboration & Communication Excellence 
 
 Outstanding collaboration skills with proven ability to work effectively across Sales, Support, Engineering, Product, and executive teams. 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating technical documentation, training materials, and presentations for various audiences. 
 Experience facilitating technical discussions and translating business requirements into technical solutions. 
 
 Quality & Process Excellence 
 
 Meticulous attention to detail with unwavering commitment to quality and accuracy in all deliverables. 
 Process-oriented mindset with experience developing and implementing best practices, standards, and quality assurance frameworks. 
 Proactive approach to identifying risks, preventing issues, and continuously improving implementation methodologies. 
 
 Additional Qualifications 
 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience). 
 Experience with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall) and tools (Jira, Asana, etc.). 
 Familiarity with data governance, security compliance (SOC 2, GDPR), and enterprise architecture principles. 
 Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously while maintaining high standards. 
 
 What’s In It For You: 
 We want our employees and their families to thrive. In addition to comprehensive benefits, we offer holistic mind, body, and lifestyle programs designed for overall well-being. Learn more about ZoomInfo benefits here .  
 
 Incredibly strong onboarding program - be set up for success in your first 90 days 
 Ongoing training to help you grow 
 Market-leading product offering (check our long list of G2 awards) 
 Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision 
 Eligibility for Future Equity Awards 
 401k Matching (50% of the first 7% of your contribution) 
 12 weeks Parental Leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks for secondary caregivers 
 Family forming benefits up to $20k, plus discounts on a Care.com membership 
 Virgin Pulse Wellness Program 
 Optional add-ons such as pet insurance, legal service support, and more! 
 
 This role is a hybrid position, with the option to work from home on Mondays & Fridays. Must be located within 30 minutes of Vancouver, WA, Waltham, MA, or Bethesda, MD 
 The US base salary range for this position is $85,000 to $93,000, plus annual bonus and benefits.

jobs.title: Executive Producer - Brand Creative
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
jobs.excerpt:
In the early 1900s, Sergei Diaghilev transformed ballet by bringing together extraordinary artists across disciplines. He paired Stravinsky with Picasso, Coco Chanel with choreographers, composers with painters. He wasn’t the person on stage, but he created the conditions that made extraordinary work possible. Every production demanded creative ambition, difficult tradeoffs, relentless coordination, and uncompromising standards.  
 Great creative production feels a lot like that. 
 Mercury is building a financial company that people genuinely love to use. We’re combining thoughtful design, technology, and AI to make financial workflows simpler, more powerful, and more human. Our Brand Creative team exists to bring that ambition to life through everything we make. 
 We’re looking for our first Executive Producer to establish Creative Production as a core capability within Brand Creative. You’ll lead production across our most ambitious campaigns and projects while building the systems and external network that allow exceptional creative work to happen again and again. 
 You see production as a creative discipline. You know how to protect bold ideas, challenge underdeveloped briefs, make difficult tradeoffs, and bring clarity to complexity. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to build the function while still personally producing our biggest creative bets. 
 In this role, you’ll: 
 
 Own production across Brand Creative campaigns and projects, balancing priorities, capacity, staffing, budgets, timelines, and risk across multiple concurrent initiatives. 
 Personally lead our most ambitious campaigns and selected projects from concept through delivery across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated work. 
 Partner with creative leaders to turn ambitious ideas into production plans that hold up against timing, budget, and reality, challenging underdeveloped briefs and protecting the creative idea through execution. 
 Build and lead an exceptional network of agencies, directors, studios, photographers, freelancers, and production partners that expands our capacity without lowering the bar. 
 Establish how Brand Creative prioritizes, staffs, greenlights, reviews, and delivers projects, creating a production system that makes exceptional work more repeatable. 
 Bring clarity to complex projects by keeping creative leaders and cross-functional partners grounded in the real state of the work, decisions, constraints, tradeoffs, and risks. 
 Work directly with Brand Creative leadership to continually raise the quality of the work and build one of the strongest in-house creative teams in the industry. 
 
 What you’ll bring: 
 
 Significant experience leading complex, multidisciplinary creative production, with a track record of independently owning large-scale campaigns and multiple concurrent creative projects. 
 Deep production experience across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated brand work, with the judgment to choose the right production model for the idea. 
 Strong financial and operational judgment, including experience with scoping, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and managing meaningful production investments. 
 A track record of building production systems, capabilities, or ways of working, not simply operating within established ones. 
 Experience building and managing an exceptional network of agencies, production companies, directors, studios, freelancers, and vendors. 
 Strong creative judgment and the confidence to challenge briefs, protect ambitious ideas, and make difficult tradeoffs without losing sight of the work. 
 Exceptional communication and partnership skills across creative teams, marketers, executives, and external partners. 
 The ability to bring calm, clarity, and sound judgment to ambiguity. You're excited to build the function from the ground up and still want to personally produce the work. 
 
 Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities or special needs. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

   Total Rewards The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits. 
 Our salary and equity ranges are highly competitive within the SaaS and fintech industry and are updated regularly using the most reliable compensation survey data for our industry. New hire offers are made based on a candidate’s experience, expertise, geographic location, and internal pay equity relative to peers.

Sales Development Representative - Boston Seaport - Hybrid (3 days onsite) 
 About Nasuni: 
 Nasuni delivers a unified data platform for enterprises facing an explosion of unstructured data, combining storage and data services into a single hybrid cloud solution. Nasuni’s approach enables business resiliency and better data management, while providing solutions that drive IT efficiency. Its best-in-class solution also eliminates the need for additional cybersecurity measures or separate backup and disaster recovery. The Nasuni File Data Platform replaces the friction associated with legacy infrastructure with optimized infrastructure flow, supporting modern enterprise expectations for data analytics and business insights. Nasuni helps businesses transform data from an obstacle into an opportunity. Guided by our leadership principles—Unify to Win, Innovate to Lead, and Level Up to Scale—Nasuni is creating the foundation for how modern businesses store, use, and unlock the value of their data in the age of AI.  
 What You'll Do: As an SDR at Nasuni, you'll embark on a dynamic journey to grow your sales career. Your responsibilities include researching enterprise accounts, prospecting via multiple channels (cold calls, warm calls, zoom, email, Outlook, text, events, LinkedIn, and social media), and generating interest in Nasuni's Hybrid Cloud File Data solutions. You'll collaborate closely with our Field Sales team to schedule meetings and build strategic partnerships. 
 Required Skills & Experience: 
 
 Passion for Sales: You're eager to launch or advance your career in Enterprise B2B sales. 
 Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential. 
 Outbound Prospecting: Experience in outbound prospecting via phone, email, and social media. 
 Technology Enthusiast: Curious about  IT Services, IT Products, software product technology, particularly Cloud File Storage and SaaS solutions. 
 Analytical Thinking: You possess strong analytic and problem-solving abilities. 
 Organizational Skills: Ability to manage sales outreach efficiently and prioritize effectively. 
 Adaptability: Thrive in a fast-paced environment and adjust to evolving priorities. 
 Persistence: You're determined to foster client relationships and uncover their needs. 
 Positive Attitude: Overcome barriers with optimism and resilience. 
 Research Skills: Ability to research customers and tailor introductions to decision makers. 
 Sales Tools: Aptitude to learn sales tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Salesforce, Salesloft, etc. 
 
 Join Us: Ready to advance or launch your Sales career with Nasuni in the heart of Boston Seaport? Apply today and be part of our mission to revolutionize hybrid cloud data solutions!

GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems.
