jobs.title: Go-To-Market (GTM) Digital Natives Program Leader
jobs.excerpt:
SLSQ127R420 
 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered. 
 As the GTM Digital Native Programs Leader , you will operate as the de facto COO and scale pipeline and consumption for the high-growth Databricks’ Digital Native vertical. You will partner in a "two-in-a-box" model with the Industry GTM Leader to translate strategy into durable, repeatable commercial execution across a rapidly scaling global field organization. You will work closely with sales and field engineering leaders to ideate, build, execute, and scale global programs.  
 You will play a critical role in shaping Databricks’ growth trajectory. You will be part of a lean GTM leadership that powers sellers to deliver measurable business outcomes through scale & leverage. You will be the lead orchestrator for your industry vertical, at the center of a mandate to inspire executives, drive industry outcomes, and unleash Databricks’ partner ecosystem in the high-growth SaaS space.  
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Strategy & Operating Model 
 
 Operating Model Ownership: Own and implement end-to-end op-model (across Sales, FE, Product, Engineering, Developer Relations, Partners) in a consistent global approach. 
 Product-GTM Strategy: Inform the annual Digital Native strategy by synthesizing product telemetry and engineering roadmaps with field signals to identify Big Bets in the digital natives space. 
 Data-Driven Product Feedback: Synthesize learnings from internal (field, product, engineering, developer relations) & external (customer, partner, developers) stakeholders into durable best practices  
 
 Market Presence & Influence 
 
 Internal Executive Influence: Wield two-way influence on Databricks’ Field (Sales, FE, Business Dev), Product & Engineering leadership: i.e., reflect industry signals in product roadmaps, as well as translate product activation goals into verticalized industry programs 
 Market Presence: Own and engage with technical & business customer and partner executives, build market presence to uncover signals on technical friction, business value and Databricks differentiators. 

 Industry Evangelism: Serve as a visible evangelist & thought leader (e.g., open source advocacy, scaling AI adoption), representing Databricks’ at key customer, partner, industry and developer forums 
 
 Execution & Accountability 
 
 Full-Funnel Program Design: Select & design the industry’s programs across products (and verticalize product programs) across the full funnel: demand generation → pipe creation & progression → consumption 
 Asset Creation: Create high-quality and scalable program assets that will be used by the full field (Sales, FE, BD, Marketing, Ecosystem) at scale 

 Field Activation & Community: Drive continuous field adoption of program assets and outcomes by cross-pollinating best practices across product and field teams in high-impact community cadences. 
 Ecosystem Integration: Collaborate with the partnership, ISV, and Data Marketplace teams to drive adoption of a seamless, interconnected data-sharing ecosystem. 

 Outcome Measurement: Deliver commercial outcomes by establishing measurement and monitoring systems that track product telemetry, industry & partner program performance. 

 Executive Accountability: Drive cross-functional leadership accountability for program adoption and outcomes through continuous monitoring and executive influence. 
 
 What We Look For 
 Strategic & Operational Mindset 
 
 COO Mindset: Proven ability to act as the operational backbone of a business vertical, focusing on pipeline health, organizational efficiency, and execution. 
 Strategic Execution: A track record of defining and translating complex industry strategies into durable, "field-ready" commercial motions for large organizations. 
 Programmatic Vision: Experience developing global, scalable GTM frameworks - moving beyond "one-off" deals to create a scalable engine for growth. 
 
 Technical & Domain Expertise 
 
 Technical Chops: Technical knowledge on Databricks critical for this market. Comfort with discussing  AI & LLM, Lakehouse, Lakebase, governance  

 Industry POV: A strong point of view on macro trends in high-growth SaaS and key persona triggers, helping to shape our industry advantage against peers. 

 Open Source Knowledge: A strong understanding of the open-source ecosystem and how it integrates with proprietary enterprise platforms. 
 AI Builder Experience: Proven track record of hands-on experience building AI systems (MLOps, GenAI apps, or large-scale predictive models). 
 
 Execution & Analytical Skills 
 
 Full-Funnel Expertise: Deep understanding of sales play mechanics, including lead generation, pipeline progression, and consumption drivers. 

 Scale Orientation: A "multiplier" mindset with a passion for activating large-scale field organizations and cross-pollinating best practices. 
 Entrepreneurial Spirit: A "doer" mindset with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and drive results across cross-functional teams. 
 
 Leadership & Scale 
 
 Influence Without Hierarchy: Ability to influence & drive outcomes across senior executives & global teams via influence, clarity & presence versus direct reporting lines. 
 Cross-Functional Orchestration: Skill in collaborating with Product, Engineering, and BD leadership to align product roadmap shifts with commercial requirements specific to high-growth SaaS customers. 
   
 Pay Range Transparency 
 Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. jobs.title: Operations Manager, Influencer Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. We're looking for a Manager of Influencer Marketing to build and scale the operational backbone of our global influencer program. This is not a traditional campaign role — you'll be the person who turns creator relationships and regional programs into a repeatable, data-driven machine. You'll own the systems, playbooks, and tools that allow our influencer marketing team to operate efficiently at scale across markets and content types. 
 This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy and program operations, and is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, loves building things from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of bringing structure to a fast-moving space. 
 You will: 
 Program Operations & Scale 
 
 Design and manage the operational infrastructure for a global influencer program spanning multiple content types, markets, and campaign types 
 Partner with web systems team to manage front-end, creator facing authenticated portal as well as back-end systems 
 Build scalable workflows in our CRM system for influencer sourcing, contracting, onboarding, activation, and reporting — reducing manual lift while increasing output 
 Define and maintain program standards, SLAs, and intake processes across internal stakeholders and external partners 
 Partner with legal, finance, and other internal and external partners to streamline contracting and payment operations globally 
 
 Global Playbooks 
 
 Develop and maintain a suite of global playbooks covering influencer program application management, relationship tiering, campaign briefing, content guidelines, and performance benchmarking 
 Localize frameworks for regional teams while preserving global consistency in brand standards and measurement methodology 
 Establish best practices for new program verticals (e.g., live events, product launches, always-on ambassador programs) and codify learnings into repeatable resources 
 Train and enable cross-functional partners and regional teams on playbook adoption 

 CRM & Tooling 
 
 Lead the buildout of a centralized influencer CRM and creator-facing portal — defining data architecture, contact management standards, tagging taxonomy, and relationship history tracking 
 Build, evaluate, implement, and own influencer marketing technology (CRM platforms, discovery tools, reporting dashboards) and serve as the internal subject matter expert 
 Partner with data and analytics teams to develop dashboards that give real-time visibility into program health, creator performance, and spend efficiency 
 Ensure creator-facing portal is dynamic and up to date with our backend updates, and tooling for influencers adoption and usage. 
 Identify gaps in existing tooling and build or commission solutions that reduce friction and improve team output 

 You have: 
 
 8-10 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, or a closely related field, with at least 2 years in a role focused on operations, program management, or marketing technology 
 Exceptional project management skills — highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a rapidly changing environment 
 Demonstrated experience building or significantly improving influencer marketing infrastructure — playbooks, workflows, CRM systems, or reporting tools 
 Comfort operating across global markets and working with regional teams to adapt centralized frameworks 
 Strong analytical skills; able to work fluently with data to drive decisions and communicate program performance to leadership 
 Clear, concise communicator who can translate complex operational concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences 
 A bias toward building: you'd rather create a system than patch a problem 
 Experience in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech — particularly with creator ecosystems tied to UGC or live platforms 
 Familiarity with influencer contract structures, FTC guidelines, and international compliance considerations 
 Background in or exposure to marketing analytics, business intelligence tools, or data pipeline basics 
 Experience supporting large-scale live events or product launches with influencer programming components

The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page . Annual Salary Range $191,340 — $234,390 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: GTM Product Specialist
jobs.excerpt:
About Remote 
 Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote. With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role. We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform. 
   
 If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work! What this job can offer you 
 
 Own and continuously improve one or more GTM products that support how Remote acquires, serves, and grows customers. 
 Translate business needs into scalable product capabilities, workflows, and system improvements. 
 Contribute to product strategy and roadmaps, working within Remote’s broader Revenue Technology direction and architecture. 
 Build and ship GTM product features and process improvements using automation and AI tools. 
 Partner with stakeholders across Revenue Operations, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Business Systems, Data, AI, and Engineering. 
 Lead meaningful initiatives from discovery through delivery, adoption, and ongoing optimization. 
 Develop your product, technical, and strategic skills while helping evolve the technology that powers Remote’s go-to-market organization. 
 
 What you bring 
 
 Experience managing or significantly contributing to business systems or technology products within a GTM or Revenue Operations environment. 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end revenue processes, system integrations, data models, and workflow automation. 
 Experience translating business requirements into clear product requirements and scalable system solutions. 
 Ability to manage a product backlog, contribute to roadmaps, prioritize competing requests, and define measurable outcomes. 
 Sound judgment in determining whether a need should be addressed through configuration, automation, AI, custom development, or existing technology. 
 Experience delivering cross-functional initiatives from initial discovery through implementation and adoption. 
 Curiosity and practical experience using AI-assisted tools to build, automate, or improve GTM workflows and internal tooling. 
 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements, explain trade-offs, and build alignment. 
 Experience with technologies commonly used across GTM, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, LeanData, Outreach, Salesloft, Clari, Gong, ZoomInfo, Clay, Qualified, APIs, integration platforms, or business intelligence tools. 
 Strong analytical, automation, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 Ability to work independently while knowing when to involve senior product, architecture, data, or engineering partners. 
 Fluent written and spoken English. 
 Experience working remotely is not required but is considered a plus. 
 
 Key Responsibilities  
 
 Own the roadmap, backlog, delivery, and lifecycle of one or more defined GTM products or product areas. 
 Develop a strong understanding of the users, business processes, data, and systems supported by your products. 
 Gather and clarify business needs, identify underlying problems, and translate them into well-defined product requirements and scalable solutions. 
 Prioritize initiatives and enhancements based on business value, user impact, effort, risk, and alignment with the broader GTM technology strategy. 
 Define success measures and use data, stakeholder feedback, and product performance to guide continuous improvement. 
 Design and deliver solutions using system configuration, automation, AI, integrations, custom development, or third-party technology. 
 Contribute to build-versus-buy evaluations and technology recommendations in partnership with senior product and technical stakeholders. 
 Partner with cross-functional teams throughout discovery, solution design, testing, release, and adoption. 
 Identify dependencies, risks, and architectural considerations, escalating or partnering with senior specialists where appropriate. 
 Maintain effective product governance, documentation, release planning, stakeholder communications, and enablement materials. 
 Monitor adoption and performance, resolve recurring pain points, and recommend opportunities to simplify or improve the technology landscape. 
 
 Practicals 
 
 You'll report to: Manager, Revenue Operations 
 Team: Revenue Operations – GTM Systems 
 Team size: 4-5 
 Location: We welcome applications from all locations, but will prioritize candidates based in EMEA and East Americas as we continue to diversify our teams. 
 Start date: As soon as possible 
 
 Application process 
 Roughly 3–4 hours across 2–3 weeks 
 
 Interview with Recruiter 
 Interview with Hiring Manager 
 Practical Product Exercise and Discussion 
 Interview with Revenue Operations Leadership 
 Bar Raiser Interview 
 Prior employment verification check   
 Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries. 
 At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.  We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The base salary range may be subject to change. jobs.excerpt:
The Business Development Representative, Partnerships, Physical AI will report to the Strategic Partnerships Manager and will be responsible for identifying, sourcing, and qualifying new partnership opportunities across partnership categories within the Physical AI ecosystem. In this role, you will help build and maintain a healthy partner pipeline while serving as a key operational backbone for the partnerships function: owning the CRM, partner communications, and internal materials. This role requires strong organization, clear communication, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment. 
 This role is approximately 70% outbound sourcing, qualification, and partner-facing work, and 30% CRM ownership and internal materials management. 
   
 In this role, you will: 
 Core (outbound & qualification): 
 
 Identify and source potential partner candidates across partnership categories within the Physical AI space through inbound engagement, outbound outreach, and market mapping 
 Triage partner prospects by sharing and reviewing intake forms to assess initial fit 
 Coordinate and, as needed, lead discovery calls to qualify prospects against defined partnership criteria 
 Qualify partner prospects by sharing and reviewing intake forms, assessing candidates against defined criteria 
 Present qualified prospects to the partnership team for pilot consideration 
 Coordinate and support partner-facing touchpoints as needed 
 
 Supporting (systems & materials): 
 
 Own and maintain the CRM for partnerships, ensuring accurate, up-to-date records of partner prospects, pipeline stage, and outreach history 
 Draft clear, tailored outreach and follow-up communications to partner prospects at each stage 
 Keep internal materials (intake forms, partner one-pagers, tracking sheets, FAQs) current and easily accessible for the broader GTM team 
 Collaborate with the partnership team to refine qualification criteria and improve the intake-to-pilot handoff 
 Take on ad-hoc projects related to partner research, market landscaping, or process improvement 
 Share out learnings on Physical AI partner trends, competitive landscape, and what's resonating in outreach 
 
 Success in this role looks like: consistent growth in qualified partner pipeline and increasing pilot conversion rates for prospects you've sourced and qualified. 
   
 Ideally, you will have: 
 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience 
 Ability to understand Scale's product offerings and how they apply to the Physical AI ecosystem 
 Ability to communicate Scale's value proposition clearly to both business and technical audiences 
 Passion for what you do, and the creativity and willingness to think outside of the box

 At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don’t stop there: we’re creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters.

We're remote-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks. 
 BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person’s unique skills and experiences. We’d love to hear from you—you might be just what we’re looking for, whether in this role or another. 
 ✨ Let’s give businesses more time for what matters. Make your impact within a rapidly growing Fintech Company 
 In this role, you will work collaboratively with Enablement, RevOps Leadership, & GTM leadership advising on the best way to achieve our team’s business goals from a process methodology and enablement perspective. 
 The ideal candidate is an experienced communicator.  This role will be all about optimizing how we give and get information in a hybrid world and enabling our GTM employees and leaders to do their best work. We’d like this role to focus on connecting employees with the right information at the right time, champion best practices and norms for synchronous and asynchronous communication, and empower teams and leadership to be great communicators.  
 The Internal Communications Manager will specifically support our GTM department and will be a core contributor to our success at scale. You will focus on amplifying key information and driving clarity to all levels of the organization through incredible attention to detail and operational excellence. This person will have a wide scope of autonomy and ownership to create and implement new content and systems to deliver effective communications. 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 
 Own end-to-end GTM event planning and coordination — including RKO, President's Club, CRO All Hands, and other large-scale GTM programs — driving logistics, communications, and cross-functional alignment to deliver seamless, high-impact experiences for the field. 
 Create templates and playbooks with our partners in Compensation, Operations, and Enablement to cascade information within the GTM org; be a core communications advisor who plays a key part in our change management .  
 Understand and diagnose main communications problem areas in the org, working cross-functionally to come up with solutions and roll those out over time. 
 Use the power of storytelling and design to build impactful and effective presentations and communications. 
 Work across our Strategy and Operations and GTM Leadership Team to help communicate changes to the wider GTM floor 
 Develop metrics and processes that allow continuous improvement and development of GTM events and program

 3+ years of relevant experience in experience in a communications and or enablement

 Highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to ensuring operational excellence.

jobs.title: Influencer Marketing Specialist
jobs.excerpt:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.  
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.  
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. We're looking for an Influencer Marketing Specialist to join our and help bring influencer campaigns to life. This is an execution-focused role built for someone who is highly organized, creator-savvy, and eager to get hands-on experience across all facets of influencer marketing — from day-to-day campaign coordination to supporting live events on the ground. 
 You'll work closely with senior team members to support a roster of creators, keep campaigns running on time, and be a key point of contact for influencers throughout their partnership journey. If you love being in the mix, thrive in fast-paced environments, and take pride in getting the details right, this role is for you. 
 You will : 
 Campaign Support 
 
 Assist in the end-to-end execution of influencer campaigns — supporting briefing, content review, posting coordination, and performance tracking 
 Manage campaign timelines and deliverable trackers, flagging risks and keeping all parties aligned 
 Partner with internal teams to draft creator briefs, talking points, and campaign recaps under the direction of senior team members 
 Coordinate with internal teams (creative, legal, social, events) to ensure influencer content is on-brand and delivered on schedule 
 Pull and compile performance data from influencer platforms and internal dashboards to support weekly and campaign-level reporting 
 
 Event Support 
 
 Serve as an on-the-ground point of contact for influencers at live events — managing logistics, schedules, and real-time needs 
 Help coordinate influencer travel, accommodations, and event-day itineraries in partnership with the events and operations teams 
 Support event activations from pre-production through wrap, ensuring creator experience is smooth and on-brand 
 Assist in capturing content moments and documentation at events for post-event recaps and learnings 
 
 Relationship Management 
 
 Act as a day-to-day contact for a defined roster of creators and their management teams, building trust and maintaining positive ongoing relationships 
 Track creator deliverables, communicate deadlines, and follow up to keep partnerships on schedule 
 Help onboard new influencers into the program — sending contracts, answering questions, and walking partners through the process 
 Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in the influencer CRM, including contact info, campaign history, and relationship notes 
 Monitor creator content, community sentiment, and platform activity to surface relevant updates to the team 
 
 You have: 
 
 3-4 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator relations, talent management, social media, or a closely related field 
 A genuine understanding of the creator landscape — you follow creators, know the platforms, and can speak fluently about content trends 
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously without dropping the ball 
 
 You are: 
 
 Clear, professional communicator — comfortable drafting emails to creators and their reps, and working cross-functionally with internal teams 
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift and no two days look the same 
 Detail-oriented and proactive — you spot what needs to happen next and take initiative to make it happen 
 Familiar with influencer platforms, social media analytics tools, or creator CRM systems is a plus 
 
 Nice to Have 
 
 Experience supporting live events or experiential marketing activations 
 Exposure to influencer contracting, gifting programs, or affiliate/commission structures 
 Background in gaming, entertainment, or consumer tech with knowledge of UGC creator communities 
 Proficiency in Google Suite and knowledge of creator focused tools like Tubular, CreatorIQ, etc

All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page . jobs.title: Demand Generation Program Manager | United States | Remote
jobs.excerpt:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 
 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. 
 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity  
 Grafana's Demand Generation team creates and accelerates pipeline across the full customer journey. We run a modern, AI-forward operation: lifecycle email programs driven by an AI engine, territory-level buying signals surfaced directly to sales leaders, and agentic workflows that handle work that used to take teams of specialists. 
 Our webinar program is one of the highest-leverage things we run: technical, practitioner-first sessions on a weekly cadence across AMER, EMEA, APAC and LATAM, putting the product in front of the people who would actually use it. Hands-on sessions, not sales pitches. 
 We're hiring a Webinar Program Manager to own it. This is a specialist seat, not a generalist one. You'll inherit an established program with a documented process and a full handover from the person who built it, and you'll own the operating rhythm from there: the calendar, the presenters, the build and promotion of every session, the follow-up, and the reporting. 
 This is not a "run the playbook" role. Sessions run in parallel at a pace no one could manage by hand, so the way to raise quality is to keep automating the mechanics. We expect this person to build with AI as a default and treat automation as a first-class deliverable, not a side project. 
 You'd be joining a demand gen team that is genuinely rebuilding how the function works, where AI agents run real production programs and the people on the team design the machine rather than turn the crank. The webinar program already produces, and much of the pipeline it touches starts with a session rather than a seller. You're not here to prove webinars matter. You're here to make each one produce more with less manual work behind it. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 
 Own the webinar calendar end to end. Presenter booking, registration pages, campaign setup, promotion, live delivery, follow-up, and the flip to on-demand, across multiple regions and time zones. 
 Keep sessions practitioner-first. Brief technical presenters, shape the outline, and keep a session useful to the audience that registered for it. 
 Bring data to topic planning. Use past performance and downstream pipeline quality to recommend what we run and what we retire, and lock the plan with demand gen and product marketing each quarter. 
 Automate the production line. Extend the automation behind session setup and promotion, and keep pushing into the parts of the process a person shouldn't be doing by hand, including repurposing recordings into other content. 
 Report on what happens after the session. Registrations are the input. Connect sessions to product adoption and pipeline, report it honestly, and flag what isn't producing. 
 Grow the program's reach. Expand into additional languages and formats where the numbers justify it. 
 
 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 
 4+ years in demand generation, event marketing, or lifecycle marketing at a B2B software company (open source or developer-focused a plus). 
 Hands-on ownership of a recurring webinar or virtual event calendar across multiple regions. A cadence you were accountable for hitting, not a handful of one-off sessions. 
 Hands-on with a webinar platform (ON24, Zoom Webinars, Contrast, Goldcast or similar) and the plumbing behind it: CRM campaigns, registration sync, attendance data, follow-up triggers. 
 Comfortable working with technical presenters. You can brief an engineer or solutions architect and hold the line on what the audience came for. 
 Hands-on with AI in your actual work: you've built automations or agentic workflows (or are visibly on that path), and you think about AI as leverage, not a threat or a buzzword. 
 Comfortable with data: you can pull your own numbers, sanity-check them, and build a program readout a VP would trust. 
 Strong program management fundamentals. Twenty-plus moving pieces at once is a logistics job before it's a marketing job, and you ship on time without needing a coordinator. 
 
 Bonus Points For 
 
 Content repurposing at scale: clips, blog, social, on-demand libraries. 
 Localized program experience, and a view on when translation earns its cost. 
 Familiarity with the observability, monitoring or open source ecosystem. 
 Customer.io, Salesforce and a modern data stack (BigQuery or similar). 
 Experience with product-led motions alongside sales-led ones. 
 
 In the US, the base compensation range for this role is $ 100,000   - $ 120,000 .  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. 
 *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 
 Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 
 
 100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. 
 Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.

 Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. 
 Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Marketing and Communications
jobs.excerpt:
Perplexity is scaling at a pace few companies experience, and the Communications and Marketing team is growing with it. We're hiring a Business Operations Manager to build and run the operating system underneath, so an incredibly busy team can move fast and stay in lockstep.

That means keeping the wheels turning: the tool stack, agencies and vendors, budgets, contracts, and the dashboards leadership relies on. It also means building what doesn't exist yet, and making sure everyone knows what's happening and nothing gets dropped. Half builder, half connective tissue. If you like turning ideas into things people use every day, this role is for you.

What you'll do

 - Own the marketing and comms tool stack: evaluate, procure, onboard, provision access, train the team, and retire what we've outgrown

 - Build and maintain internal tools such as calendars, intake forms, dashboards, trackers, and automations, and keep them reliable as more people depend on them

 - Run the team's operating rhythm: priorities, launch and campaign calendars, planning cycles, and the cross-functional handoffs that carry work from idea to launch without dropped threads

 - Manage agencies, contractors, and vendors from selection and onboarding through scopes, invoices, renewals, and performance

 - Keep contracts and procurement moving with Legal and Finance so agreements never become the bottleneck

 - Be the connective tissue across the team: know who's working on what, spot dependencies early, and keep people aligned without adding meetings

 - Act as a thought partner and triage point to leadership: keep them informed, spot problems early, know when to escalate, propose solutions, and see them through

 - Add rigor without slowing anyone down, knowing the difference between process that helps and process that's overhead

What you bring

 - 4-7 years in marketing operations, business operations, or a similar systems-and-process role, ideally in a fast-growing technology company

 - You build things. You've stood up tools, automations, or dashboards yourself, and AI tools are already part of how you work

 - Strong analytical instincts, able to turn messy inputs into numbers leadership can trust

 - Experience managing agency, contractor, or vendor relationships and working with Legal and Finance on contracts and procurement

 - Exceptionally organized and genuinely relational. People like working with you, tell you things early, and trust you with what's really going on

 - A clear, direct communicator who can brief an executive, run a cross-functional meeting, and write a process doc people actually follow

 - Demonstrated experience working closely with and as a trusted partner to senior executives

 - Comfortable in ambiguity and thinks in scale, building things that hold up when the team, budget, or number of launches doubles

 - No specific tool stack required. You've operated marketing or comms systems in a high-growth environment and can pick ours up fast

jobs.excerpt:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice 
 Who we are: 
 
 Shape a brighter financial future with us. 
 Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance. 
 We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world. 
 The role: 
 SoFi is seeking an energetic, organized, and resourceful Direct Mail Marketing Manager for a one-year contract to manage the end-to-end direct mail creative process for the SoFi Credit Card product, from strategy and planning through creative development, stakeholder review, approval, production, and tracking. This role will also analyze campaign performance and provide recommendations to optimize future direct mail strategies and creative. 
 At SoFi, you’ll become part of a new kind of finance company whose ambition is to help our members achieve financial independence and reach their goals. We aim to be at the center of our members’ financial lives and help every member get their money right. We created student loan refinancing, addressing the biggest financial challenge of a new generation through a modern approach to lending and personal finance. Next, we expanded our products and services across loans, investing, and cash management. SoFi has achieved significant growth, with ambitious plans ahead, but to continue this growth, we need great talent. And that starts with you. 
 What you’ll do:  
 This role owns four core areas of responsibility: 
 1. Creative Strategy & Planning 

 Lead end-to-end creative strategy and execution for Credit Card direct mail campaigns, partnering with Product Marketing Manager (PMM) to align initiatives with business goals, priorities, and growth objectives. 

 Lead quarterly creative planning with the creative agency, using audience insights, customer behavior, performance data, and test-and-learn principles to develop strategic recommendations for the Product Marketing Manager. 

 Lead upfront data and audience planning with DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science and agency team defining targeting, segmentation, personalization, measurement requirements, and data inputs that inform the creative strategy, testing plan, and campaign brief. 

 Own the creative roadmap and partner with the creative agency to develop compelling messaging, visual storytelling, offers, personalization, branding, and calls to action. 

 2. Campaign & Production Management 

 Serve as the day-to-day campaign lead and primary liaison among Product Marketing Manager, the creative and data strategy agency, DM Data Strategy, Marketing Data Science, other internal stakeholders, and print vendors. 

 Serve as the lead DM representative in Credit Card business unit meetings, Marketing Data Science handoff meetings, and other recurring meetings. Prepare slides as needed, capture key decisions and action items, and distribute notes to appropriate stakeholders. 

 Translate approved strategies into actionable campaign plans, creative briefs, testing plans, and production requirements. 

 Manage monthly direct mail tests and creative variations, ensuring audience definitions, segmentation, data requirements, personalization, and creative variants are aligned and executable. 

 Own campaign timelines and the shared production calendar, including data due dates, creative milestones, review rounds, release dates, print dates, and drop dates. 

 Manage assets, versioning, production samples, dependencies, risks, and bottlenecks to ensure campaigns launch accurately and on time. 

 Maintain the monthly campaign matrix, including audience targeting, creative variations, testing plans, data requirements, and other campaign details. 

 Partner with Marketing Data Science to update campaign matrices and verify that targeting and personalization information is accurate before each drop. 

 Lead weekly status meetings with Product Marketing Managers, including agenda development, stakeholder alignment, and action-item follow-up. 

 3. Compliance, Quality & Operations 

 Lead the Compliance and Legal review process for direct mail materials, partnering with Product Marketing and the creative agency to ensure executions meet regulatory, disclosure, brand, and business requirements. 

 Manage creative review and quality control across messaging, data, personalization, offers, URLs, disclosures, and final production files. 

 Serve as the central point of accountability for ensuring every campaign is accurate, compliant, data-aligned, approved, and production-ready. 

 Manage campaign production and postage costs, partnering with the DM billing team to keep campaigns within budget. 

 4. Performance, Insights & Competitive Intelligence 

 Partner with Marketing Data Science, analytics, and the creative agency to evaluate campaign and creative test results against product and business goals. 

 Translate audience, performance, and campaign data into actionable insights that inform creative recommendations, messaging, offers, personalization, segmentation, and future test strategies. 

 Lead weekly Product Marketing Manager performance updates and monthly reporting, presenting results and optimization recommendations to Product Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders. 

 Apply campaign learnings to improve future direct mail initiatives and inform the creative roadmap. 

 Build and maintain a competitive direct mail library, monitoring competitor activity, creative trends, offers, formats, personalization, and audience strategies. 

 Share monthly competitive and performance insights with the broader Marketing organization to inform future campaign and product marketing strategy. 

 What you’ll need: 

 Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting direct mail or other marketing campaigns within financial services or another highly regulated industry. 

 Experience partnering with cross-functional teams to execute complex, multi-channel campaigns and operational initiatives. 

 Experience managing high-volume direct mail, CRM, lifecycle, or integrated marketing creative execution, ideally within financial services, credit cards, banking, or another highly regulated industry. 

 Strong project and production management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, creative versions, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously. 

 Highly proficient in Google Workspace, particularly Google Sheets, Docs, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar, Tableau, Snowflake; comfortable building and maintaining detailed trackers and production workflows. 

 Strong understanding of creative development, production, version control, review/approval processes, and vendor management. 

 Experience working directly with Legal, Compliance, Creative, Marketing, Analytics, Data, and external production vendors. 

 Strong attention to detail and a high level of ownership, particularly when managing personalized credit card communications where small errors can have significant downstream impact. 

 Comfortable working in a test-and-learn environment, using campaign performance data to inform future creative decisions. 

 Excellent communication and organizational skills with the ability to keep senior stakeholders informed while driving day-to-day execution. 

 Financial services or credit card marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly familiarity with regulated marketing, compliance reviews, disclosures, and credit-related communications. 
 
 Compensation and Benefits

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (Austin)
jobs.excerpt:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us 
 Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.  
 About the role: 
 We're hiring a Business Development Representative to join our Austin office and help accelerate pipeline generation across our Commercial and Enterprise business segments. This is a full-time position based out of our Austin office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two-three days in the office each week to connect and build as a team. As a BDR you’ll partner closely with Sales Directors to identify and engage target accounts, multi-thread into strategic organizations, and generate qualified pipeline through personalized outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and video. You’ll work directly with modern data leaders and technical buyers at fast-growing and enterprise organizations evaluating cloud data infrastructure, analytics modernization, AI initiatives, and data integration strategies. 
 Technologies You’ll Use 
 Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Lusha, Nooks, ChatGPT and AI prospecting tools, Gong, Google Workspace, Slack, Vidyard / Loom 
 In this role, you can expect to: 
 
 Generate qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting across target accounts 
 Research accounts, industries, and personas to craft personalized outreach 
 Partner closely with Sales Directors to build account strategies and prioritize opportunities 
 Execute multi-channel outbound campaigns using phone, email, LinkedIn, and video 
 Conduct discovery conversations to uncover business challenges, technical pain points, and initiatives 
 Engage data, analytics, engineering, IT, RevOps, and executive personas 
 Maintain accurate activity, contact, and opportunity data within Salesforce 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Partnerships, and Sales leadership 
 Leverage AI tools and sales technologies to improve prospecting efficiency and messaging quality 
 Consistently achieve and exceed activity, meeting generation, and pipeline target 
 
 You are a good fit if you: 
 
 9+ months of experience in SaaS, cloud, infrastructure, or technology sales development 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage technical and business stakeholders 
 Ability to learn and articulate technical concepts related to data, analytics, cloud, and AI infrastructure 
 Experience with outbound prospecting and multi-threaded account engagement 
 Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities simultaneously 
 Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or sales engagement platforms to improve research, messaging, and productivity 
 Coachable, curious, resilient, and motivated by a high-performance sales environment 
 Fluent in English. Bonus points if you're bilingual  
 
 You'll have an edge if: 
 
 Experience selling into data, analytics, engineering, or IT organizations 
 Familiarity with modern data stack technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, or cloud data warehouses 
 Experience using Outreach, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or Gong 
 Previous experience working in a high-growth SaaS environment 
 Demonstrated success exceeding outbound pipeline generation targets 
 
 Compensation & Benefits: 
 
 Salary: We offer competitive compensation packages commensurate with experience, including salary, equity, and performance-based pay. Our Talent Acquisition Team can answer questions around dbt Lab’s total rewards during your interview process. 
 
 Equity StakeBenefits - dbt Labs + Fivetran offers: 
 
 Unlimited PTO (and yes, we use it!) 
 Excellent healthcare 
 Paid Parental Leave  
 
 What to expect in the interview process (all video interviews unless accommodations are needed):  
 
 Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner  
 Interview with Hiring Manager 
 Interview with Peer 
 Final Interview - SDR Challenge 
 
 #LI-HYBRID OTE (On Target Earning) $80,000 — $100,000 USD   
 Perks and Benefits 
 
 100% employer-paid medical insurance * 
 Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off 
 RSU stock grants* 
 Professional development and training opportunities 
 Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities 
 Monthly cell phone stipend 
 Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. 
 
 * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information 
 Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. 
 
 We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion , but more importantly, we’re proud of our  core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream . Read about us in  Forbes .      
 Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities. 
 To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video. 
 To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here . 
 
 We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form . We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best

jobs.title: Regional Marketing Manager | West Coast | Remote
jobs.excerpt:
Grafana Labs, the company behind the open observability cloud, is founded on the principles of open source, open standards, open ecosystems, and open culture. Grafana Cloud, our fully managed observability platform, is flexible and built for scale. With Grafana Cloud's actually useful AI, organizations can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data to move at the speed of their ambitions. Today, more than 35 million users and 7,000+ customers – including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce – trust Grafana Labs to ensure reliability of their applications and systems, resolve incidents quickly, and optimize their telemetry to reduce noise and cost. We are a 100% remote company with 1,600+ team members across 40+ countries, and we’re backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X . 
 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. 
 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. The Opportunity: 
 In this role, you are responsible for executing regional marketing strategy and independently leading programs that drive measurable business outcomes. Working within regional priorities, you are trusted to make decisions, adapt plans as conditions change, and take ownership of program performance from planning through results. 
 Approximately 50% of your work is self-directed, requiring sound judgment, strong prioritization, and accountability for outcomes. Success in this role comes from balancing execution with strategic thinking, identifying opportunities for improvement, and sharing best practices that increase team effectiveness. 
 You are expected to leverage AI as a core part of your work, applying it thoughtfully to improve productivity, scale repeatable processes, and enhance decision-making. This includes identifying where AI can create efficiencies, where human judgment remains essential, and developing workflows that can be adopted across the team. 
 What makes you a Great Fit: 
 
 Lead regional marketing programs from planning through execution and retrospective, including program strategy, budget management, goal setting, delivery, and performance reporting. 
 Execute ABM and regional marketing initiatives, partnering closely with Sales and SDR teams while contributing to prioritization and program planning. 
 Independently manage day-to-day decisions, proactively address risks, and escalate issues when appropriate. 
 Serve as a proficient user of core marketing platforms, including Splash, Zuddl, Salesforce, and Monday.com, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and tooling. 
 Develop and document AI-enabled workflows that improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across marketing operations, event execution, and reporting. 
 Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation across regional marketing programs and contribute to the development of shared team processes and best practices. 
 Analyze program performance and translate data into actionable insights and recommendations. 
 Plan and manage projects independently, set realistic timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and deliver on commitments. 
 Provide guidance and support to Associates, contractors, and other team members on shared initiatives. 
 Build expertise in Grafana's go-to-market strategy, regional marketing programs, and the ecosystem of channels, vendors, and partners that support growth. 
 
 What you'll bring at this level: 
 
 Located on the West Coast of the United States 
 3-5 years in field or regional marketing, or events, including end-to-end ownership of programs 
 Strong project, time, and stakeholder management, with consistent attention to detail 
 Independent proficiency with Splash, Zuddl, Salesforce, and Monday.com or similar 
 Demonstrated experience operationalizing AI in marketing work: reusable prompts, documented processes, or lightweight automations 
 Open source go-to-market motion and the regional market a plus 
 Willingness to travel approximately 40% 
 
 What success looks like at: 
 
 The program you own runs cleanly, from start to finish, and hits its goals. 
 You keep moving as priorities shift, without direction at each step. 
 Problems get caught and handled before a customer ever feels them. 
 Your reporting leaves people with a story and a lesson, not just numbers. 
 The AI workflows you build get picked up by others, so the team produces more without adding headcount. 
 You find and close process gaps, and the junior teammates you guide do better work for it. 
 
 Compensation & Rewards: 
 In the US, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is  $123,000 - $147,000. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally. 
 *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process. 
 Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs: 
 
 100% Remote, Global Culture -  As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose. 
 Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment. 
 Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates. 
 Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things. 
 Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work. 
 Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics. 
 Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career. 
 Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human. 
 Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do. 
 In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.  
 Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable. 
 
 Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow. 
 Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings. 
 #LI-Remote 
 
 For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy .

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
About Betterment 
 Betterment  is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease.  We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays). 
 About the role 
 We're hiring ambitious, tech-savvy Business Development Representatives to join one of three teams driving top-of-funnel growth across Betterment's retirement and advisor solutions businesses: 
 
 Direct 401(k) BDR — builds pipeline with small and mid-sized businesses looking to launch or switch their 401(k) plan. 
 Advised 401(k) BDR — builds pipeline with financial advisors and RIAs looking to offer or improve 401(k) plans for their business-owner clients. 
 Custody BDR — builds pipeline with independent RIAs evaluating or switching custodians for Betterment Advisor Solutions (BAS). 
 
 In each of these roles, you'll own outbound prospecting at the top of the sales funnel — an activity-heavy role where you'll identify, engage, and qualify prospects before handing off warm opportunities to Account Executives. You're a self-starter who's comfortable with high call/email volume, quick to learn a technical product, and motivated by hitting (and beating) targets. 
 Candidates will be considered for the team(s) whose current hiring needs best match their background and interests; the specific team will be confirmed during the interview process. 
 This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees.  
 
 New York City: $60,000-$65,000 
 
 This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of commission. 
 A day in the life 
 Core Responsibilities (All Teams) 
 
 Generate new opportunities using outbound tactics (email sequences, cold calling, LinkedIn, etc) to assist the sales process at the top of the funnel. 
 Identifying, targeting and nurturing potential outbound opportunities by creating new target lists and always being one step ahead of trends. 
 Understanding the need of prospects and communicating them clearly to Account Executives. 
 Clearly articulating Betterment’s Advised value proposition and products to prospects in specific verticals. 
 Meet and exceed meeting set and pipeline goals. 
 Ensure effective and consistent use of Salesforce & other prospecting tools. 
 Provide “voice of the prospect and industry” to marketing and product management to drive roadmaps. 
 We are a close knit team - we work hard, collaborate to get things done and celebrate our wins! 
 
 Direct 401(k) BDR 
 
 Prospect small and mid-sized businesses that are launching a first-time 401(k) plan or looking to switch providers. 
 Engage business owners, HR leaders, and finance decision-makers directly (no advisor intermediary). 
 Position Betterment's 401(k) offering as part of a company's employee benefits strategy. 
 
 Advised 401(k) BDR 
 
 Prospect financial advisors and RIAs who want to add or improve a 401(k) offering for their business-owner clients. 
 Work with decision-makers evaluating whether to add a retirement offering to their practice or transition existing retirement plan business to Betterment. 
 Articulate Betterment Advisor Solutions' value proposition to advisors serving the retirement plan vertical. 
 
 Custody BDR 
 
 Prospect independent RIAs evaluating or switching custodians. 
 Understand and speak to the needs of RIAs regarding custody, technology, and platform support. 
 Position Betterment Advisor Solutions (BAS) as a modern alternative for RIAs re-platforming their custody relationship. 
 
 What we’re looking for 
 
 No experience necessary, however recent sales (or sales adjacent) experience is a plus (i.e. recruiting, real estate, or non-profit experience). 
 B2B tech/SaaS sales experience as an SDR/BDR is a plus. 
 Curiosity and interest for financial products and retirement planning. 
 Demonstrated track record of high performance. 
 High energy and willingness to learn. 
 Strong oral and written communication skills with even stronger listening skills. 
 Relentless in your pursuit of success and are willing to put in the extra effort to achieve your goals. 
 Experience with sales & marketing technology stack. 
 Join a team built on these core values 
 We change lives 
 Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease . 
 We set audacious goals 
 We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins. 
 We value all perspectives 
 When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community. 
 We simplify financial services 
 We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA. 
   Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being: 
 
 We offer a competitive suite of benefits , including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options 
 Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants. 
 Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year. 
 Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees. 
 Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments. 
 
 What happens next 
 We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues. 
 In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions. 
 On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.  
 We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process! 
 Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.  
 Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. 
 Come join us!  
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
About Gusto 
 At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve. 
   All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy . 
   AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process. About the Role: 
 We’re expanding our Sales team and looking for driven Business Development Representatives (BDRs) to generate new opportunities. As a BDR, you'll be the first point of contact for prospective customers. Your responsibility will be to identify businesses that could benefit from Gusto, reaching out through thoughtful cold outreach, and starting conversations that turn into real opportunities for our Account Executives. 
 This is a high-energy, prospecting-focused role built for someone who's hungry to grow a career in sales. You'll spend your days researching accounts, running outbound campaigns across phone, email, and social, and qualifying interest before handing off well-vetted opportunities. You'll learn the fundamentals of a top-tier sales motion and have a clear path to advance into a closing role. 
 Here’s what you’ll do day-to-day: 
 
 Outbound Prospecting: Conduct over 100 cold calls to prospective buyers, facilitating next steps such as scheduling meetings for account executives to further qualify leads. 
 Qualify Opportunities:  Identify and nurture a large volume of prospects to qualify leads through multiple channels.  
 Educate & Inspire: Communicate Gusto’s value to prospects and customers, highlighting how our platform helps businesses streamline operations and better serve their employees. 
 Collaborate with AEs: Partner with Account Executives to drive pipeline generation, account planning, and meeting conversion. 
 Maintain CRM Hygiene: Accurately log all activities and insights in Salesforce and maintain a disciplined, data-driven approach to outreach. 
 Hit Goals & Grow: Consistently meet monthly and quarterly quotas and metrics, while contributing to a high-performing team culture focused on results and career development. 
 AI Fluency: Use AI-powered workflows as a core part of how you sell: running assigned tools daily, surfacing friction and inefficiencies as you find them, and collaborating with your team to influence what gets built or improved next. 
 
 Here’s what we're looking for: 
 
 1+ years of sales or outbound prospecting experience, ideally in SaaS, HCM, HR Tech, or FinTech but specific industry experience not required 
 Expertise in outbound prospecting and sales strategy, with a proven track record of success. 
 Advanced written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft and deliver compelling messaging. 
 Strong command of Salesforce, Outreach, Zoominfo, Claude (or other AI Models) and similar tools with demonstrated mastery in managing the sales pipeline. 
 Strong judgment in handling complex situations, including decision-making in ambiguous or challenging scenarios. 
 Takes initiative and requires minimal direction, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams. 
 Solid understanding of the accounting industry or payroll/HR tech and its role in business operations. 
 Ability to engage with high-level decision-makers and executives. 
 Proven, day-to-day experience integrating AI into how you work — across writing, research, prep, and summarization as a core part of your workflow, with a track record of giving clear, useful feedback that helps improve your tools and processes. 
 
 Our cash compensation range for this role ranges from $27.17 - $31.90 per hour with a 20% commission structure in the Denver location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above. 
 Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale. 
 Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.  
 When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees. 
 
 Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.  
 Gusto is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Gusto considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Gusto is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. We want to see our candidates perform to the best of their ability. If you require a medical or religious accommodation at any time throughout your candidate journey, please fill out this form and a member of our team will get in touch with you. 
 Gusto takes security and protection of your personal information very seriously. Please review our Fraudulent Activity Disclaimer . 
 Personal information collected and processed as part of your Gusto application will be subject to  Gusto's Applicant Privacy Notice .
