jobs.excerpt:
Datadog is seeking a  Field Marketing Manager to support and execute high-impact programs across the North Central region in North America. In this role, you’ll collaborate with regional Sales and Marketing teams to drive pipeline generation and deliver engaging in-person and virtual event experiences. You’ll take ownership of regional marketing initiatives, gaining hands-on experience across campaign strategy, execution, and cross-functional alignment. This is an exciting opportunity for a results-driven marketer looking to make an immediate and measurable impact. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Plan and execute field marketing programs, including Datadog Live events, third-party sponsorships, customer panels, workshops, and executive experiences 
 Manage field projects from planning through execution, ensuring on-time, on-brand delivery 
 Own on-site logistics and execution for smaller, high-touch regional events 
 Collaborate with Sales, Demand Generation, Marketing Ops, and other teams to maximize event engagement 
 Track and analyze program results to evaluate pipeline impact and optimize future campaigns 
 
 Who You Are: 
 
 3–5 years of experience in B2B marketing, preferably in the technology industry 
 Creative and results-oriented, with a strong passion for customer-centric event experiences 
 Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines 
 Independent, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking initiative 
 You communicate clearly and effectively in English, both in writing and speaking. 
 Familiarity with Salesforce, Google Suite, and project management tools is a plus 
 Willingness to travel up to 40% 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 
 Benefits & Growth: 
 
 Generous and competitive benefits package 
 New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan 
 Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
 Employee-focused best in class onboarding 
 Internal mentor and cross-departmental buddy program 
 Friendly and inclusive workplace culture 
 
 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. 
 #LI-Hybrid Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $98,000 — $131,000 USD 
 About Datadog:  
 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center. 
 
 Equal Opportunity at Datadog: 
 Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.  
 Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form . This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.  
 Privacy and AI Guidelines: 
 Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog’s  Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice . For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines .

resume_core.summary: Product Marketing Manager with 6+ years across enterprise B2B SaaS, fintech, and AI platforms, and an MBA in Business Analytics and Machine Learning. Proven track record of developing positioning, messaging, go-to-market launches, and sales enablement for technical products sold to enterprise buyers. Skilled at translating complex technology into customer stories and executive-level narratives, and at using performance data to refine what works.

experience.title: MBA Intern, Product Marketing & Sales
highlights: Led 40+ discovery conversations with C-suite prospects as the first commercial hire, defining customer profiles and use cases that shaped content and product roadmaps.
Wrote targeted outbound messaging frameworks and localized content, lifting outbound engagement rates to 25%+.
Built SQL and Tableau dashboards to identify lead-to-demo funnel friction and inform segmentation, contributing to a 30% improvement in lead-to-demo conversion.
Designed a stage-based user-activation roadmap with triggered email sequences and ran sequence tests to improve activation.

experience.title: Marketing & Analytics Specialist
highlights: Owned solution-track campaigns end to end by product line and region across 50+ countries (LinkedIn sponsored content, Eloqua email), including campaign design, metrics, and guardrails; increased marketing-qualified leads 28%.
Equipped 50+ account executives with messaging playbooks, first-call decks, and competitive talking points, reducing campaign execution timelines by 15%.

Partnered with account-based marketing teams on campaigns targeting named banks across North America and the Middle East; developed account-specific messaging and reviewed all campaign content for product accuracy.
Developed customer success stories for banking clients, coordinating stakeholder and legal approvals before publishing them and repurposing them into social and email content.
Planned and ran Finacle Day, the annual flagship customer event with 5,000+ attendees, end to end, alongside executive roundtables and customer briefings with bank leadership.
Increased content engagement 2.4x using SQL and Tableau to evaluate campaign performance and guide content optimization, including email tests across banners, length, CTA, and form length.

experience.title: Lead Consultant, Product Marketing
highlights: Owned positioning, messaging, and executive narratives for ZIF, an AI-driven IT operations (AIOps) platform, translating technical capabilities into customer use cases and business value.
Delivered 80+ live product demonstrations and led CXO discovery calls as first client touch, influencing software procurement decisions globally.
Coordinated cross-functional product launches with Product and Engineering, defining positioning, messaging, and launch plans.
Directed product benchmarking studies against AIOps alternatives, producing competitive talking points for sales and positioning inputs for product.
Rebuilt the product website and authored technical content (blogs, solution briefs, presentations), growing website engagement 40%.
Wrote customer success stories and case studies for healthcare enterprise clients, turning implementation outcomes into proof points for sales and campaigns.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
highlights: Grew digital acquisition footprint 200% and secured 50M+ impressions through integrated, multi-channel campaigns.
Generated ~$35K USD through online fundraising campaigns using structured conversion optimization across funnels.
Unified frameworks across marketing, legal, and finance to ensure compliance and streamlined execution.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; Seattle, WA
jobs.excerpt:
The Company You’ll Join 
 Carta is the connected platform and AI-native ecosystem for private capital. Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Trusted by 55,000 companies and 1.8M+ equity holders in 160+ countries, and 10,000 funds and SPVs representing $250B+ in assets under management, Carta is transforming how private capital operates. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work. 
 For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page . The Problems You'll Solve 
 At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As Performance Marketing Manager you’ll work to:  
 
 Deploy Winning Strategies for Paid Media Across All Segments. Evaluate and implement diversified multi-channel, full funnel media plans that create demand with buyers across all segments and business units – from SMB to Mid Market and Enterprise. 
 Drive Channel Efficiency. Expand our global digital footprint and generate high-quality sales opportunities that support our ambitious growth targets. Identify and evaluate the effectiveness of our channels across paid search, digital ads and third party media and review sites. Improve return on ad spend and optimize channels through a pragmatic test and scale approach. 
 Support Campaign Execution Excellence: Design, manage, and optimize paid activities for marketing campaigns to meet direct response, demand generation, and awareness objectives.Work closely with campaign managers, content, product marketing, sales, and operations  to align messaging, optimize lead handoff, and drive full-funnel success. 
 Embrace Innovation and Experimentation. Be on the forefront of paid advertising and demand generation trends and tools, deploying high-potential pilots and scaling the most promising outcomes. Conduct rigorous A/B testing on ad creatives, landing pages, and targeting to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and efficiency. 
 Grow and Improve Paid Media Results through ABM and Personalization. Develop campaign executions which support ABM and Demand at Scale, including new full-funnel personalization strategies through the deployment of innovative creative and ad formats.Collaborate with web, organic search and organic social stakeholders to extend learnings across teams. 
 
 The Performance Marketing Manager  plays a critical role in setting and executing paid media strategy to deliver on pipeline targets across all of Carta’s business units. This role is an essential partner for Campaign Management, Web, Content, Customer Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Business Operations both in the US and in EMEA/AMEA regions.  
 The Team You'll Work With 
 You’ll be joining our Performance Marketing Team reporting to our Performance Marketing Lead. The Performance Marketing team is responsible for driving meaningful and high quality lead volume and pipeline growth. We are flexible, data-driven, and equally focused on scale and efficiency. Our team is made up of collaborative, strategic thought partners focused on problem solving. 
 About You 
 
 A strategic and analytical thinker who can distill complex marketing concepts and performance insights for an executive audience  
 6+ years of experience  in demand generation and/or performance marketing with at least 3 years experience in B2B   
 Fluent in Ad platforms and networks (e.g. Google Ads, Google Display Network, GA4, LinkedIn, Reddit, OpenAI) 
 Familiar with Marketing Automation and Attribution tools (Marketo Measure, Dreamdata, Salesforce) 
 Experience using data visualization tools to craft narratives (e.g. Looker, Tableau, etc) 
 Fluent  in  Personalization, ABM Platforms and DSPs (e.g. 6Sense, Contentful, Qualified, etc) 
 BA required 
 SaaS experience across SMB, Mid-Market and Enterprise segments strongly preferred 
 Understanding of the latest in marketing mix modeling and predictive analytics preferred 
 
 Salary 
 Carta’s compensation package includes a market competitive salary, equity for all full time roles, exceptional benefits, and, for applicable roles, commissions plans. Our minimum cash compensation (salary + commission if applicable) range for this role is:  
 
 $127,500 - $150,000  in San Francisco, CA and New York, NY  
 $121,125 - $142,500 in Seattle, WA  
 
 Final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other factors. 
   
   Disclosures: 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.  
 Carta uses E-Verify in the United States for employment authorization. See the E-Verify and Department of Justice websites for more details. 
 For information on our data privacy policies, see  Privacy ,  CA Candidate Privacy , and Brazil Transparency Report . 
 Please note that all official communications from us will come from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to security@carta.com.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
About Formlabs: 
 Do you want to change how the world creates? 
 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. 
 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. 
 Your Impact:  
 We’re looking for a   Product Marketing Manager with a strong communications background to drive market adoption of our 3D printers, and related accessories and materials. You will work on our core SLA technology and products, and manage the overall go-to-market strategy across the company, through core messaging and positioning, new product launches, content creation, sales enablement, analytics, and understanding of the market and competition. Product Marketers at Formlabs are expected to be the closest to our products and our customers - sitting between the Product and Marketing teams, with a talent for attention-grabbing copywriting. 
 Product Marketing at Formlabs is a pivotal team, where you will work with product management, design, engineering, manufacturing, web, and content to get things done. This is a fast-paced environment, where we launch new materials to market every few months, with large hardware announcements every couple of years. 
 If you’re passionate about reinforcing product messaging across everything we do in sales, services and marketing, we want you to join our team as a Product Marketing Manager . 
 What You'll Do:  
 
 Be the “quarterback” of our launches of our new hardware, software, and materials products 
 Nurture existing products by executing changes in marketing and positioning 
 Connect market and technology trends with Formlabs’ products to build product positioning and messaging for verticals, buyer personas, and use cases 
 Regularly track, and assess competitors, and adjust Formlabs’ product marketing accordingly as industry situation changes 
 Communicate our products across all mediums in succinct and compelling ways, and anticipate and circumvent possible confusion or questions 
 Develop technical training, messaging decks, internal FAQs, product guides, etc. that allow our sales team to succeed while driving competitive differentiation 
 Promote and demo Formlabs products at conferences, trade shows, events and to analysts and potential customers 
 Develop deep expertise in our 3D printing technologies, materials, and portfolio 
 
 About You: 
 
 2-5 years of experience in a product marketing or sales engineering role at a B2B hardware or software company 
 Detail-oriented with a track record of excellence in project management

jobs.excerpt:
About Formlabs: 
 Do you want to change how the world creates? 
 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. 
 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. 
 About Form Now 
 Form Now is a startup within Formlabs, backed by a small, fast-moving team of about 20 people. It's the next step in furthering Formlabs' mission: giving anyone, from individual builders to engineering teams, access to high-quality 3D printing without owning a printer. Users upload a model, choose from high quality materials, and Formlabs handles production, bridging the gap between idea and reality without the upfront cost of a machine. As the sole marketer for this business, you'll have full ownership of a marketing function and the challenge of scaling it from the ground up. 
 Your Impact:  
 We're looking for a Marketing Generalist to own growth for Form Now end to end. We need someone who can wear many hats, from working on customer acquisition, to launching and iterating quickly on new campaigns. You'll need to be strong analytically, comfortable running email, events, and LinkedIn outreach, and willing to try channels you haven't touched before. You'll work directly with leadership to connect what the product can do with how we message and sell it to new customers. 
 Breadth matters more than depth here. We'd rather have someone who can move fast across five channels than someone who's only ever gone deep on one. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Use analytics to identify where Form Now should grow next: which customer segments, which channels, and which campaigns are actually working 
 Own campaign effectiveness end to end: set up email and LinkedIn campaigns, run them, and measure what drove results 
 Independently plan and execute events as a channel for reaching new B2B customers, from small businesses to medium and large accounts 
 Connect Form Now's product roadmap to marketing: turn what the product does into positioning and messaging that lands with buyers 
 Pull together campaign analysis, competitive tracking, and channel experiments into a coherent growth plan you own end to end 
 Make A/B testing and fast iteration a habit rather than an occasional exercise; ship, measure, adjust, repeat 
 Write and manage customer-facing copy and email, from acquisition sequences to lifecycle messaging 
 Use AI tools, including Claude, as a daily part of the job to move faster on research, campaign builds, and analysis 
 
 About You: 
 
 2-10 years of B2B marketing or growth experience; slope and grit matter more than years 
 A track record of taking on projects solo, from concept through execution, and knowing how you measured success 
 Comfortable being customer-facing when the job calls for it 
 Strong analytically: you can build a manageable tracking system, read your own campaign data, and act on it without waiting for someone else to hand you a dashboard 
 Have run or set up events independently 
 Growth mindset: you're not precious about the channel you know best and you'll try new approaches quickly 
 High energy and not afraid to be scrappy; a startup-within-a-startup environment means undefined problems and few guardrails 
 Use AI tools fluently in your daily work, held to the same quality bar as your own 
 
 Bonus Skills:  
 
 B2B experience specifically 
 Experience with data analytics and visualization tools (GBQ/SQL, DataStudio/Looker, etc.) 
 Comfortable with copywriting and customer marketing, even if it's not your primary strength 
 You've built your own tools, whether that's a scraper for a prospect list, an automation that stitches two tools together, or a landing page you shipped without waiting for design.

A day in the life AWS Search Marketing is focused on delivering a great search experience for AWS customers and prospective customers. We manage SEO and SEM across search engines like Google, Bing and others. These are key sources of traffic for how customers find the information they need by engaging with AWS. Our focus on the customer and applying best-in-class search practices results in a test and learn culture that seeks continual progression. jobs.title: Program Manager, AWS Marketing, AWS Launch Operations
jobs.excerpt:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) brings new services and features to customers at an unprecedented cadence — more than 3,000 launches a year, and accelerating as the AI landscape evolves. Behind that velocity is the Launch Operations team, which owns the process that governs the lifecycle of bringing every AWS capability to customers, from intake through customer availability. We turn AWS’s innovation velocity into a durable Marketing advantage: driving operational scale so service teams and stakeholders can focus on innovation, and improving signal-to-noise so the most important news reaches customers and enables field sales and partner teams to engage around the launches that matter most. We are looking for a Program Manager II to run the programs that make this possible. You will operate at the center of the launch process, coordinating across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, and field teams to keep launches moving on time and at a high quality bar. This is a role for someone who is organized, resourceful, and energized by the challenge of managing high-visibility, cross-functional programs where the details matter and the scale is significant. You will not just track the process — you will improve it, identifying where the sequential handoffs and manual coordination slow launches down, and designing the workflows and tooling that compress that timeline and align launch velocity with engineering velocity. Key job responsibilities 1. Own the end-to-end launch operations program — defining milestones, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and keeping launches on schedule across multiple concurrent workstreams and stakeholder teams. 2. Coordinate across product managers, marketing, engineering, security, legal, pricing, and field teams to align on priorities, remove blockers, and drive launches from intake to customer availability. 3. Identify process gaps in how launches move through the pipeline and implement improvements that raise quality, reduce cycle time, and compress the sequential handoff chains that dominate the launch timeline. 4. Partner with task-owner teams to bring automation directly into their review workflows, improving operational scale so the program can support 3,000+ launches per year. 5. Define and monitor program metrics to measure delivery performance and improve signal-to-noise, then use those insights to inform planning and elevate the most important launches to customers. 6. Apply generative AI tools to streamline processes, status reporting, and program analysis, and help embed these tools into the team’s day-to-day operating model. A day in the life You start your morning reviewing the launch pipeline and flagging any launches at risk of slipping, then work with the relevant task owners to unblock them. Mid-morning, you run a working session with product and marketing partners to align on upcoming Tier 1 launches and lock down next steps. After lunch, you pull together a status update for leadership, summarizing progress, program metrics, and the open decisions that need their input. Between meetings, you are refining the intake process for new launches and looking for ways to remove friction and automate the manual coordination that slows the next cycle down by prototyping that improvement with generative AI tooling before you socialize it with the team. About the team The AWS Lifecycle Marketing team shapes how the world’s leading cloud and AI portfolio reaches customers. We orchestrate how AWS launches are integrated with Marketing planning, how lifecycle changes are managed responsibly, and how the portfolio is represented across shared surfaces and priority moments — removing complexity, increasing visibility, and ensuring Marketing can act with the coordination, speed, and strategic focus the portfolio requires. Launch Operations is the connective tissue between AWS Service Engineering and AWS Marketing, and this role sits at the heart of a multi-year transformation from manual, relationship-driven coordination to scalable, data-driven platforms. If you want to work on programs that shape how millions of customers experience AWS innovation, we would love to hear from you.

Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe, LLC. is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 What you’ll do 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Support the Regional sales leaders with intelligence and insight to accelerate growth; 
 Support the Sales Strategy and Operations colleagues by standardizing global and regional common process that is currently decentralized; 
 Provide a deep dive into key performance metrics and drive deep understanding of business performance; 
 Problem solve and provide structure analysis outcomes for complex sales operations challenges through data, analytics and insight; 
 Identify new opportunities and areas of productivity efficiency gains for Regional sales leadership; 
 Participate in projects defining go-to-market approaches, as well as in regular business and resource planning.  
 Run analysis on key performance metrics, and provide relevant insights for managing the business; 
 Oversee the implementation of enabling systems and tools, and work closely with internal systems teams; 
 Prepare weekly senior leader forecast materials and provide ongoing updates on key business growth/metrics to leadership teams; and 
 Manage bespoke projects and effectively manage stakeholders. 
 
 Who you are 
 Minimum requirements 
 Must have a Bachelor's Degree or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management and Systems, or a related field, plus seven (7) years of related experience in Sales, Strategy, and Operations, of which at least five (5) years must be post-bachelor's progressive work experience. In the alternative, the employer is willing to accept a Master's Degree or foreign equivalent degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Management and Systems, or a related field, plus five (5) years of related work experience in Sales, Strategy, and Operations. 
 Must also have five (5) years of experience with each of the following: 
 
 SQL and other advanced analytic tools to develop and run complex SQL queries and analyze large data sets; 
 BI visualization tools, including Tableau; and 
 Working with data and large data sets to identify trends and create insights to make recommendations to senior leaders. 
 
 Must also have four (4) years of experience with the following: 
 
 Using AI to improve productivity and reduce manual processes, and automated reporting dashboards. 
 
 Must also have three (3) years of experience with each of the following: 
 
 Manage cross-functional stakeholders and managing expectations and timelines; and 
 Working with and manipulating large data sets to deliver deep analyses and actionable insights. 
 
 Multiple positions available. 
 Salary: $155,800.00 - $233,600.00/yr 
 This salary range represents the base salary range for the role and any sales commissions /sales bonuses targets, if applicable, would be in addition to the base salary. 
 40 hrs/week 
 50% Telecommuting permitted. 
 Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends. NY65

jobs.title: Solutions Marketing Manager, Cybersecurity
jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 You will be a strategic contributor to our cybersecurity marketing efforts, positioning Claude as the trusted AI partner for CISOs, security operations teams, threat intelligence analysts and beyond. This is an important role that requires deep understanding of the cybersecurity ecosystem combined with the ability to craft compelling positioning and messaging around AI's benefit to defenders and the organizations they protect. 
 Working closely with sales, product, partnerships and communications teams, you'll be responsible for bringing cybersecurity launches, features, and messaging to market through various channels while ensuring cohesive positioning across audiences. 
 This role needs someone who can set vision and strategy while being hands-on with execution, from launching product capabilities for security operations and sector-specific tools to quarterbacking demand generation campaigns that drive adoption. Working at the intersection of AI safety, the evolving threat landscape, and campaigns, you'll help shape industry conversations around AI's role in cyber defense that drive measurable pipeline and impact results. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Coordinate and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy for cybersecurity across key segments: enterprise security operations, threat intelligence, detection and response, governance/risk/compliance, MSSPs and more 
 Craft differentiated positioning and messaging across solutions pages, campaign materials and content for distinct audiences within the vertical 
 Support go-to-market for product and solution launches including sector-specific offerings and relevant MCP integrations and skills (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence platforms, etc.) 
 Partner with the alliances team on joint go-to-market with cybersecurity partners, including shared positioning, launch coordination, and integrated campaign moments across security platform and services partners 
 Partner with communications on executive thought leadership regarding AI's potential to tip the balance toward defenders, including flagship announcements in the context of key security initiatives 
 Work with the social and content teams on a cybersecurity content calendar that highlights use cases, case studies, and partnership announcements 
 Drive thought leadership initiatives and speaking / event opportunities relevant to the security community 
 Enable sales teams with compelling materials, outbound campaigns, and pipeline-driving initiatives for security-led enterprise accounts 
 Report on which channels and campaigns are driving results and identify opportunities for iteration 
 
 Minimum qualifications 
 
 Have direct experience marketing software products to security audiences, including familiarity with how CISOs, SOC leaders, and security engineering teams evaluate and buy technology 
 Thrive in a 0-to-1 environment — can build processes where none exist and navigate ambiguity across a complex stakeholder landscape 
 Are an adaptable generalist with exposure and competency within multiple marketing functions (content, campaigns, social, analytics, sales enablement) 
 Have strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to translate complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling narratives for both technical practitioners and non-technical audiences 
 Are a quick learner who can absorb context on security workflows, buyer dynamics, and compliance frameworks rapidly 
 Excel at cross-functional collaboration — comfortable being the connective tissue between product, sales, partnerships, communications, and marketing teams 
 Are passionate about AI's potential to strengthen cyber defense while maintaining focus on responsible, safe deployment 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Have 8+ years of marketing experience with at least 2 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, or the broader security technology space 
 Have worked in or with security organizations and understand the distinct priorities and decision-making dynamics of security buyers 
 Possess experience with event marketing at security conferences (e.g., RSA Conference, Black Hat, Gartner Security & Risk, ISAC events) 
 Have a background in enterprise sales enablement, particularly in complex or regulated industries 
 Show a track record of building marketing programs from scratch at a growth-stage company 
 Demonstrate interest in the responsible deployment of AI in security contexts, including an awareness of the dual-use considerations unique to cybersecurity use cases 
 
 Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect staff to be able to work from our Washington, D.C. or San Francisco office at least once a month for cross-functional stakeholder engagement. We encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings. 
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common

jobs.excerpt:
Sales Development Representative 
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will prospect, qualify, and generate customer leads to assist in Datadog’s overall business growth segment. By partnering with internal stakeholders, you will help IT and Technology innovators across markets recognize Datadog’s impact in their digital transformation and migration to the cloud. SDRs have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success. 
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with various Datadog teams 
 Drive initial prospect qualification and schedule discovery meetings 
 Develop, present, and implement strategies for acquiring new business 
 Conduct outbound outreach by cold calling and emailing prospective customers  
 Learn to follow a well-defined methodology to help identify a customer's unique needs  
 
 Who You Are: 
 
 Motivated by a career in sales 
 Someone with an innate curiosity to learn 
 Have a desire to succeed alongside teammates 
 Proven in your written and verbal communication   
 Comfortable with being able to learn from rejection 
 
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply. 
 Benefits and Growth: 
 
 High income earning opportunities based on self performance 
 New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) 
 Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing  
 Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message  
 Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking  
 An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds 
 Generous global benefits 
 
 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog. Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan. The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is: $50,000 — $50,000 USD 
 About Datadog:  
 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

 Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager - AI, Automation & Analytics
jobs.excerpt:
Growth Marketing Manager – AI, Automation & Analytics
Hybrid in DALLAS TEXAS

Our Dallas-based Corporate Travel Services client is relaunching around an AI-first approach across travel, expense, events, and integrated payments. We are looking for a hands-on growth marketer who is equally comfortable with data, experimentation, automation, AI tools, and demand generation.

This is not a traditional marketing role focused primarily on brand, events, agency management, or managing a team.

You will be our first dedicated growth hire and will help build the growth engine from the ground up. We are looking for someone who enjoys asking, “How can I build a system to do this?” and then using data, AI, automation, and experimentation to answer that question.

You will personally build and improve the systems that help us identify the right accounts, enrich and qualify prospects, generate demand, measure pipeline, test messaging, and learn which channels actually create revenue.

What You'll Do

Build and optimize the growth engine

Own growth measurement from target account through qualified pipeline. Build dashboards, define funnel metrics, identify bottlenecks, run experiments, and make decisions based on pipeline and revenue—not vanity metrics.

Build AI-assisted prospecting and lead-generation workflows

Design workflows to identify ideal accounts and contacts, enrich data, score and qualify prospects, detect gaps or bad matches, and route qualified opportunities into CRM and outreach systems.

You should be comfortable thinking through workflows such as:

Data source? account identification? enrichment? AI analysis/scoring? human review? CRM? sequencing? measurement

We care less about whether you've used one specific tool and more about whether you have personally built and improved workflows like this.

Use AI and automation as part of your daily operating system

Use AI for research, analysis, content, campaign development, prospecting, workflow automation, and experimentation. Understand where AI can accelerate work—and where it creates risk through bad data, fabricated information, or incorrect assumptions.

Analyze the funnel and run experiments

Work directly with CRM, marketing, and sales data to understand:
•
Which accounts and personas convert

•
Where leads drop out of the funnel

•
Which channels create qualified pipeline

•
What messaging performs with different buyers

•
Which experiments deserve additional investment

You should be comfortable digging into spreadsheets and dashboards and ideally using SQL, APIs, scripting, or AI-assisted analysis to answer your own questions.

Build campaigns yourself

Create and ship campaigns, including:
•
Landing pages and microsites

•
Email and outbound programs

•
Lead-nurture workflows

•
Case studies and customer stories

•
Sales enablement materials

•
Messaging and campaign assets

Use AI-assisted design and development tools to prototype and launch quickly rather than waiting for a development queue.

Partner with Sales and Product

Stay close to customer conversations and the sales pipeline. Use what you learn to improve targeting, qualification, messaging, campaigns, and product positioning.

You will help translate complex capabilities—including AI, automation, travel, expense, payments, and agentic support—into language that makes sense to both finance leaders and end users.

What We're Looking For

Growth and analytics

•
3–7 years of experience in B2B SaaS, growth, demand generation, marketing operations, GTM, or a related growth-focused role

•
Experience connecting marketing activity to pipeline and revenue

•
Strong analytical instincts and comfort working with funnel data, spreadsheets, dashboards, attribution, and experimentation

•
Experience defining metrics, finding bottlenecks, forming hypotheses, and testing improvements

•
SQL, Python, scripting, APIs, or other technical/data skills are a plus

AI and automation

•
Practical, daily use of AI in your actual work

•
Experience building or designing automated workflows—not just using ChatGPT for writing

•
Experience with tools such as Clay, n8n, Make, Zapier, HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, Apollo, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms is valuable

•
Interest in agentic workflows and the ability to explain how you would connect multiple systems and AI steps into an end-to-end process

•
Good judgment about AI failure modes, including bad enrichment matches, hallucinated information, incomplete data, and where human review is necessary

Builder mentality

•
Evidence that you have built something from zero—a growth program, workflow, automation, channel, reporting system, side project, or other initiative

•
Comfortable being the person who figures out how to do the work and ships it

•
Comfortable with ambiguity and experimentation

•
Comfortable being the only marketer in the room

•
Comfortable saying, “I don't know yet, but here's how I would find out.”

CRM and growth systems

•
Hands-on experience with Salesforce, HubSpot, Attio, or another CRM

•
Experience with lead routing, scoring, segmentation, enrichment, sequencing, marketing automation, and/or data hygiene

•
Comfortable working across sales and marketing systems

This Role Is Probably a Fit If...

You enjoy building things yourself.

You get excited about seeing a manual process and figuring out how to automate part of it.

You regularly experiment with new AI tools and incorporate the useful ones into your actual work.

You care more about qualified pipeline and learning what works than impressions and activity metrics.

You've built something because it needed to exist—not because someone handed you a playbook.

This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If...

You primarily want to manage a team, agencies, or vendors.

Your experience is primarily brand, events, social media, partnerships, or field marketing without deep ownership of demand generation and funnel performance.

You prefer receiving a defined marketing strategy rather than building and testing one.

You use AI occasionally for brainstorming but have not incorporated automation or AI-assisted workflows into your day-to-day work.

jobs.excerpt:
Product Marketing Manager - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract

Savanta is looking for a Product Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team on a 12 month Fixed Term Contract.

This role is ideal for a commercially minded product marketer who can step into an established strategy, maintain momentum, and help shape the next phase of Savanta’s evolution as a technology‑first insights business.

About Us:

Savanta is a leading data, market research and advisory company helping the world's leading brands make better decisions, faster. With over 500 people across offices in multiple countries, we combine deep research expertise, proprietary technology and high-impact consulting to give our clients a complete view of their markets, their customers and their competitors.

About the Role:

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, the role ensures continuity and impact across go‑to‑market execution, sales enablement, content direction, and brand governance while bringing fresh perspective and commercial rigour to an established strategy.

Acts as the link between product, research, commercial, and marketing teams, translating market insight and audience needs into compelling positioning, messaging, and launch plans for Savanta’s research products and solutions.

Partnering closely with relevant leads to deliver integrated campaigns, equip commercial teams with effective tools, and ensure Savanta’s products are consistently and credibly represented across channels and markets.

You’ll shape the content narrative around our products, developing core stories and messaging pillars, and working closely with PR to turn insight into timely thought leadership and external communications.

You may also manage and brief external agencies to support campaigns, content development, or creative execution as needed.

It is ideally suited to a commercially sharp product marketer who can quickly build credibility, lead with audience insight, and help steer Savanta’s evolution into a technology‑first insights business.

About You:

You’ll own product marketing strategy and execution across our research products and solutions, partnering closely with commercial, research, and marketing teams to deliver compelling go‑to‑market activity, sales enablement, and content direction.

The ideal candidate must be:

• A commercially sharp product marketer who can hit the ground running in a senior, established role.

• Confident inheriting an existing strategy and making it your own, balancing continuity with fresh thinking.

• Strong at aligning senior stakeholders around clear positioning and audience‑led narratives.

• Comfortable setting direction for content, brand, and messaging without needing to own every execution detail.

• Experienced partnering closely with sales and commercial teams on enablement and go‑to‑market activity.

• Excited by technology‑led transformation and helping reposition a business for the future.

Benefits of Working with TP:

Please click here to view the full job description.

And in return, Savanta offers*:

• Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000

• Generous Holiday Allowance

• Hybrid working

• Flexible working practices

• Health & Wellbeing package

• Ongoing Learning & Development

• Financial health package

• Team & Company Socials

• Committees for Health & Well Being, Charities & Volunteering and DE&I

Why Join Us:

The company was founded on the belief that tech should be integral to its success, and this culture of tech innovation makes us best placed to put Savanta at the heart of our clients’ businesses offering solutions before they even know the problem.

Part of the vibrant Next 15 Communications Group, we have an entrepreneurial and inclusive company culture that actively recognizes and values its people and offers unrivalled scope for career development, including mentoring, coaching as well as extensive training programs.

Savanta is committed to being an equal opportunities employer and continuously strives to be an employer of choice. Our people are our greatest asset - we value workplace diversity and inclusion, oppose all forms of unlawful discrimination, and welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates of all backgrounds.

All candidates will be considered equally; however, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Full details of local benefits and perks: available on request from the Savanta People Team (HR).

We encourage authentic responses to demonstrate your experience and approach, rather than relying on Generative AI tools to write your cover letter or any questions in the application process. We may use AI Decoders as part of the review process and if answers match to a high extent that may be factored into the review.

For information on how Savanta uses your data, please see https://savanta.com/about/careers/job-opportunities.

 Cross-Functional Event Execution: Collaborate with internal partners on Asana-hosted events across ABM, Brand, Community, and Customer Advocacy .

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.excerpt:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role 
 As a Program Manager, Brand at Anthropic, you will be the connective tissue of our brand marketing organization. Marketing Strategy & Operations sits at the center of how the team plans, prioritizes, and executes, and as we scale, you will build and own the operating structure that keeps our teams moving. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives in ambiguity and complexity, who is energized by working across many teams, and who would rather build the system than run the same play twice. 
 In this role, you'll support program management for a portfolio of high-touch strategic work and org effectiveness programs. You'll partner closely with Comms, Brand, Enterprise Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Procurement, and you'll work directly with leadership to translate ambitious goals into clear, sequenced plans with owners and resources behind them. Some flexibility to travel is needed. 
 Key responsibilities 
 
 Lead program management and shape strategy for our flagship brand campaigns and strategic programs, from kickoff through launch 
 Run operations for our global agency retainers 
 Own the marketing onboarding program, using feedback to improve each iteration 
 Partner with leadership on ongoing reporting, team planning, priorities, and goal-setting 
 Build lightweight, simple, and flexible org processes and central resources 
 Shape culture and community programming for the marketing organization 
 
 Minimum qualifications 
 
 Have significant experience in brand program management, chief of staff, marketing operations, brand marketing, business operations, strategy, or related roles at high-growth technology companies 
 Have built, or been early in building, a marketing operations or business operations function from the ground up in a complex, fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment 
 Have excellent project management skills and can coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives effectively 
 Are passionate about translating ambiguous strategic objectives into concrete operational plans and actionable workstreams 
 Have strong analytical skills and experience building reporting frameworks, forecasting models, and performance measurement systems 
 Enjoy designing scalable programs, frameworks, and flexible org systems that people actually use 
 Work comfortably with AI tools, automations and modern productivity platforms 
 Are a strong communicator who keeps many stakeholders aligned and informed 
 Are excited about Anthropic's mission to develop AI that is safe and beneficial 
 
 Preferred qualifications 
 
 Experience running operations for large integrated brand campaigns, such as major tentpole or broadcast-scale launches 
 Experience managing external agency relationships 
 Background in budget controlling and procurement processes in partnership with Finance and Legal 
 A track record of simplifying or retiring processes that had become too heavy, based on team feedback and business needs 
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.  
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $200,000 — $255,000 USD Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience 
 Required field of study:  A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience 
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position 
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. 
 Visa sponsorship:  We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. 
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit  anthropic.com/careers  directly for confirmed position openings. 
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. 
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. 
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:  Learn about  our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Manager, B2B Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
About Betterment 
 Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings, and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors, as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses. Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days / week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).     
 About the Role: 
 Betterment is seeking an experienced B2B Marketing Manager to support demand generation efforts for our 401(k) sales organization. This individual contributor will help plan, execute and optimize integrated programs that build qualified pipeline for our 401(k) line of business, spanning nurture and lifecycle marketing, partnerships and co-marketing, paid media, ABM, and campaign execution. 
 This role is ideal for a hands-on B2B demand generation marketer with a strong paid media background and communication skills who is comfortable working across channels, building relationships with external partners, and translating campaign performance into pipeline impact. 
 This role is based out of our NYC office. Below we've reflected the base salary range we would offer for this position. Actual salaries may vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Betterment’s total compensation package for employees. 
 
 New York City: $120,000-$150,000 
 
 This job may also be eligible for variable compensation in the form of a company incentive bonus. 
 A Day in the Life: 
 You will help run the day-to-day demand generation engine for Betterment at Work, working across partnerships, lifecycle marketing, paid media, and events to generate leads and pipeline for our 401(k) sales organization. 
 
 Plan, launch, and optimize integrated demand generation campaigns across email nurture, paid media, digital channels, and event sponsorships 
 Manage paid media performance, agency relationships, and budget pacing across SEM, programmatic display, and paid social 
 Own audience targeting, segmentation, and nurture strategy across target-account and lifecycle motions 
 Own lifecycle marketing , including audience targeting, segmentation, and nurture flows that move leads through the funnel and drive expansion within existing plans 
 Drive partner co-marketing programs to develop joint campaigns, content, and events with referral partners, payroll and benefits platforms, and other strategic partners, and collaborate with business development on the day-to-day relationships 
 Partner with RevOps on lead routing, scoring workflows, and marketing automation 
 Drive optimizations across lead, MQL, and pipeline metrics and report on program performance 
 Collaborate with business development, sales, creative, product, PR, and compliance 
 Maintain social proof program and creating case studies 
 
 What We're Looking For: 
 
 4+ years of B2B marketing experience with a strong focus on demand generation and pipeline building 
 Experience planning, executing, and optimizing paid media and digital advertising campaigns; ABM experience is preferred, including target account strategy and account-level reporting 
 Experience driving partner or co-marketing programs, including joint campaigns, content, and events with external partners 
 Experience designing and running lifecycle and nurture programs, from segmentation and journey design through measurement and optimization 
 Strong experience with marketing automation and CRM tools (HubSpot and Salesforce experience is a huge plus) 
 Strong project management and prioritization skills; comfortable juggling multiple programs and stakeholders at once 
 Experience working with agencies and vendors (SEM, programmatic display, paid social, etc.) 
 Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to collaborate effectively across marketing, sales, revenue operations, and shared services 
 Experience with budget planning and performance reporting, including MQL tracking and pipeline contribution; comfortable translating data insights into actionable programs 
 Background in 401(k), fintech, or other regulated industries is a plus 
 Join a team built on these core values 
 We change lives 
 Be a part of a community of innovators working to transform financial outcomes for real people. Your work will make an impact, always laddering up to our mission; to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease . 
 We set audacious goals 
 We set them for the company, our customers, and ourselves, and we won’t stop until we reach them. We don’t just show up; we give our all, then celebrate our wins. 
 We value all perspectives 
 When we collaborate, we're at our best. We believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes and strive to uphold our supportive and inclusive community. 
 We simplify financial services 
 We’re financial services pioneers, always finding new ways to improve, optimize, and enhance. Constant improvement is in our DNA. 
   Our Commitment to Your Total Well-being: 
 
 We offer a competitive suite of benefits , including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability; infertility support and WPATH-aligned transgender health benefits; an Employee Assistance Program (EAP); transit benefits and FSA and HSA options 
 Ownership: Equity for all employees, including new hire and refresher grants. 
 Time: Flexible paid time off, paid parental leave, and a fully paid four-week sabbatical in your sixth year. 
 Growth: Company-paid professional coaching for all employees. 
 Wealth: Day-one 401(k) match plus matching on qualified student loan payments. 
 
 What happens next 
 We’ll take a few weeks to review all applications. If we’d like to spend more time with you, we’ll reach out to arrange next steps, which will include 3-4 sets of meetings with your future colleagues. 
 In the interview process, we’ll look to learn more about your skills, experiences, capabilities, and motivators. Many of our questions will be aimed at understanding how you might operate here at Betterment. Depending on the role, we may ask you to complete a case study exercise or technical assessments, as we want to collect a robust set of data points to better inform our decisions. 
 On average, it takes us around 3-5 weeks to make a hiring decision, depending on your availability and sense of urgency. As a best practice, we aim to interview at least 2-3 final round candidates before making a hiring decision. Please note that, as we usually receive an overwhelming number of  applications for open positions, we’re unable to offer individual feedback during the interview process.  
 We recognize that interviewing for a new role is a big deal. We appreciate you considering Betterment as the next step in your career, and our Recruiting Team is here to support and advocate for you through the interview process! 
 Betterment is dedicated to providing accommodations to candidates upon request. If you need accommodations at any point throughout the interview process, please reach out to your recruiter.  
 Please note that in any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information. 
 Come join us!  
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We strictly prohibit and do not tolerate discrimination against employees, applicants, or any other covered persons because of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex, gender (including gender nonconformity and status as a transgender or transsexua

jobs.title: Event Specialist, Marketing
jobs.excerpt:
About Formlabs: 
 Do you want to change how the world creates? 
 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. 
 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. 
 Your Impact:  
 Trade shows and events are where Formlabs puts our products directly in front of the people who use them, and North America is one of our most active regions on the calendar. As Event Specialist, you'll be the right hand to our NA Events Managers - involved in every show from planning to final wrap-up, and building the hands-on expertise that experiential marketing careers are built on. 
 You'll own the details that make a booth come together: ordering printed collateral, preparing displays and product samples, keeping consumables stocked, and coordinating the shipping, vendors, and campaign materials behind every show. It's a fast-paced and high-visibility role.  
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Act as the right hand to the Marketing Managers, Events (NA), involved in the planning and execution of every trade show and company event on the North America calendar 
 Order and manage printed collateral (leaflets, brochures, signage), ensuring materials are on-brand, accurate, and delivered on time 
 Prepare, track, and pack display parts, demo units, and product samples for each show, making sure the right materials are ready to ship 
 Order and manage booth consumables and supplies (e.g., cleaning and setup supplies, packaging, printer/label materials) needed for smooth onsite execution 
 Track and maintain inventory of event materials, including demo units, signage, swag, 3D-printed demo parts, and booth hardware 
 Coordinate with recurring vendors and shipping/freight partners to ensure materials arrive on time and within budget 
 Maintain internal tools such as shipping calendars, logistics trackers, and asset management systems 
 Support post-show wrap-up: processing returns, documenting damage, and assisting with invoice reconciliation 
 Support execution of pre- and post-event marketing campaigns (email, social, promotional materials) in partnership with the Marketing Manager, Events 
 Help prepare internal enablement materials for booth staff, such as demo scripts, presentation decks, and talking points 
 Support onsite booth staffing coordination and scheduling 
 Assist with gathering event performance data (leads, attendance, engagement) and compiling post-event reports 
 Coordinate with the design team to ensure booth assets, signage, and collateral are on-brand and print-ready 
 Serve as onsite support at events, helping represent Formlabs to customers, partners, and prospects 
 Up to 25% travel across North America,  to assist with onsite event marketing tasks. 
 
 About You: 
 
 1–3 years of experience in events, marketing, or logistics coordination - through professional experience, internships, academic projects, or other hands-on involvement 
 Strong organizational and project management skills; comfortable managing multiple timelines and shifting priorities 
 Familiarity with event marketing fundamentals (campaigns, collateral, brand guidelines) and/or event logistics (freight, vendors, booth operations) 
 A proactive communicator who works well cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Design, and Logistics 
 A detail-oriented, get-it-done attitude, with comfort working independently on defined projects and asking for guidance on new or ambiguous problems 
 Comfortable traveling ~25% of the time 
 
 Bonus Skills:  
 
 Experience creating or supporting event marketing content (email, social, presentations) 
 Background in B2B tech or manufacturing 
 Familiarity with international shipping, customs paperwork, or exhibit house coordination 
 
 Our Benefits & Perks: 
 
 Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs 
 Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) 
 401K matching and access to financial advisors 
 Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) 
 Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) 
 Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it 
 Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits 
 Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats 
 Regular sponsored professional development opportunities 
 Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community 
 And of course… unlimited 3D prints 
 
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.   
 Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing. 
 Our Candidate AI Guidelines are available here . Please give them a read. Compensation 
 We are all owners of Formlabs and direct beneficiaries of our success. We believe that equity is a critical component of compensation at Formlabs, and we want our newest team members to understand the potential value of their equity compensation. Full time employees receive equity, in the form of RSUs. Your financial investment will grow with us in accordance to your impact. 
 At Formlabs, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. Your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, location and expected impact on the organization. The annual base pay range for this role is: $75,000 — $95,000 USD

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
Why join us 
 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek. 
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career. Sales at Brex 
 Sales is the growth engine at Brex. We bring in new customers, expand existing relationships, and drive the company’s bottom line. With unlimited territories and uncapped opportunity, your ambition sets the ceiling. We win together, celebrate often, and reward performance. If you want to sell a category-defining product with real ownership, this is your team. 
 What you’ll do 
 As a Sales Development Representative, you will be responsible for prospecting and identifying new customers for Brex. You will partner with Account Executives to help businesses understand the value of Brex as a financial services solution and the rewards that it provides fast growing companies. We’re rapidly growing our team which requires a “whatever it takes” attitude, a high sense of urgency, and a passion for sales. As an SDR at Brex, you will have the opportunity to help create processes and build pipelines for $1 million deals immediately.  
 Where you’ll work This role will be based in our Salt Lake City office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home.
