jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
About the team 
 Note: This role is an in-office position, based in our Chicago, IL office. 
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR) at Stripe, you’ll work in a customer-facing role focused on connecting prospective customers with Stripe. You will work in partnership with the Marketing and Sales teams to create a high quality, predictable pipeline. We hire and train SDRs in a way that prepares them to be a high performing source of talent for Stripe Sales and Go to Market teams.  
 What you’ll do 
 For the first few months, you’ll be a part of our Sales Development Associate program , which is designed to accelerate onboarding and support new grads transition into their first roles in a corporate setting. Part of this period will be supported by the Sales Development Academy which  will help you quickly build and develop the foundational skills required to be successful in this role and position you for a long-term career in Sales at Stripe. Through a mix of virtual sessions, in-person practicums, and check-point quizzes, you’ll learn all about Stripe’s products and how to be a successful SDR. During this period you’ll also be partnered with a senior SDR on the team as a mentor. Along with your manager, your mentor will be there as an additional resource to help support you.  
 Within a few weeks of starting at Stripe you'll be reaching out to potential Stripe customers, pitching them on the products that could best support their business model, and partnering with senior sellers on the team who will ultimately help close deals. We take a data driven approach to the role and the success of our SDRs is largely dependent on their successful outreach to new Stripe customers.  
 While onboarding spans across the course of your first few weeks at Stripe, the Academy offers continued training and enablement over the course of your first year as an SDR to ensure top performers are set up for a successful transition to other roles on the sales team. Most regularly we see our top performing SDRs promoted into Account Executive roles.  
 If you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, interacting with customers, and being responsible for generating revenue, we’d love to hear from you!  
 Responsibilities 
 
 Contact potential customers through cold-calling, email, and social channels, or by responding to inquiries generated from Marketing activities. 
 Book meetings with potential customers (prospects) and pitch them on Stripe’s products that are a match for their business model.  
 Develop relationships with prospects to uncover specific business needs through effective, consultative questioning to qualify interest and prepare a comprehensive hand-off to sales. 
 Research and create compelling outreach materials for high-value prospects, in partnership with SDRs and Account Executives. 
 Execute outbound sales outreach created by marketing, leveraging strategic messaging to target specific segments. 
 Follow-up with potential customers who expressed interest but did not initially result in a sales opportunity, maintaining a warm pipeline. 
 Effectively manage customer outreach, consistently meeting/exceeding Service Level Agreements (SLAs), meticulously updating activity and contact information within the Customer Relationship Management system (Salesforce) to support weekly reporting efforts. 
 Collaborate and provide essential feedback and insights to Marketing to help improve targeting, messaging, and overall campaign effectiveness. 
 
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. 
 Minimum requirements 
 
 A track record of top performance or prior success in academic, extracurricular, or professional endeavors. 
 Superior verbal and written communication skills, with an ability to clearly articulate complex topics.  
 Self-starter who is highly motivated and able to operate effectively and autonomously in a hyper-growth environment. 
 This role requires in-office participation three to four (3-4) days per week in our Chicago office. 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Professional experience in a sales, customer service, or fast-paced professional environment.

jobs.title: Regional Revenue Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt:
The Regional Revenue Marketing Manager will help drive account expansion and deal acceleration through integrated regional marketing programs, with Sales as a primary stakeholder. As a key marketing partner for assigned AMER markets, you’ll collaborate with sales and marketing to build and execute programs that engage decision makers, advance buying committees, accelerate the sales cycle, and improve conversion to customers. You’ll experiment with new approaches and tools while applying a disciplined, analytical approach to measuring program performance and business impact. You are a data-guided, results-driven marketer and collaborative partner to cross-functional stakeholders. 
 We're looking to speak with candidates based in Chicago or Minneapolis for our hybrid working model. 
 Position Expectations 
 
 Contribute to and execute the field marketing plan for assigned AMER markets, in partnership with regional marketing leadership and Sales. The integrated plan may include digital programs, web and webinars, trade shows, regional events, pipeline acceleration events, and the annual roadshow, in concert with key customers and partners in the region 
 Build and execute decision-maker programs that engage executives, business leaders, technical leaders, and other influential personas across strategic accounts 
 Partner with account teams to understand account priorities, buying committees, decision-making processes, whitespace opportunities, and barriers to expansion; translate those insights into relevant programs and experiences 
 Develop and coordinate account-focused programs that support enterprise opportunities, strengthen relationships with key decision makers, and help create momentum through the sales cycle 
 Work with the wider organization to support strategies that expand usage of MongoDB across enterprise accounts and across personas, from developers to C-level executives 
 Support developer groundswell initiatives within assigned markets and contribute to tracking and reporting on developers enabled in the region 
 Generate programs that contribute to pipeline, account expansion, and net annual recurring revenue (NARR), and track and report on results 
 Be a trusted partner to regional Sales leadership and account teams by understanding territory needs and executing marketing strategies and programs that support deal velocity 
 Conduct market and account research to identify regional opportunities, relevant audiences, and effective engagement strategies 
 Work closely with regional marketing managers and cross-functional partners across AMER to align plans with Sales and Marketing goals and objectives 
 Ensure program performance, pipeline influence, and ROI are tracked consistently; use insights to optimize programs and improve outcomes 
 Support flagship events, sponsored conferences, regional events, and customer or executive experiences 
 Manage budgets for assigned programs and markets, ensuring thoughtful allocation and accurate tracking of spend and results 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Bachelor’s degree and/or 3–6 years of regional, field, revenue, account-based, or customer marketing experience in an enterprise software, B2B SaaS, or technology company 
 Experience developing programs for executive audiences, buying committees, or other enterprise decision makers; experience with account-based and/or developer marketing is a plus 
 Highly results-driven with strong analytical ability and a metrics-oriented approach to success. Able to track outcomes and demonstrate ROI for funded and co-marketing activities against budget 
 Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, or partner teams 
 Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging and programs to different audiences 
 Experience with CRM and marketing automation systems, such as Salesforce, Eloqua, Jira, or similar platforms 
 Strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment 
 Good humor and a positive, can-do attitude 
 30–50% travel to assigned markets 
 
 About MongoDB 
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 
 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. 
 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.  
 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! 
 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT US:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE

We're looking for motivated and tech-savvy Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with a strong interest in AI to join our growing sales team. In this role, you’ll play a key part in building a healthy pipeline for our Account Executives by qualifying inbound leads and proactively prospecting into high-value target accounts. This is an opportunity to be at the frontlines of a fast-moving AI company, engaging in thoughtful, technical conversations with a knowledgeable customer base.

The ideal candidate is results driven, exhibits strong intellectual curiosity of the evolving AI space, and can operate in a fast-paced, highly-dynamic start up environment. You should be comfortable initiating outreach, handling nuanced product discussions, and helping prospects understand the impact of generative AI on their business.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Strategically prospect into key accounts across email, calling and Linkedin, communicating Fireworks AI’s unique value proposition

 - Consistently meet new business opportunity and pipeline generation targets

 - Craft personalized, tailored outreach through various research methods to prioritize the right accounts and prospects

 - Qualify and engage inbound leads, ensuring a smooth transition to our Account Executive team

 - Act as a brand ambassador, educating prospects on the power and potential of our inference solutions

 - Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to refine messaging and outreach strategies based on market feedback

 - Stay current on AI/ML trends to conduct informed, relevant conversations with technical and business audiences

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

 - Demonstrated interest in technology sales, with a strong interest AI and machine learning

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to engage confidently with technical stakeholders

 - Self-motivated and organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

About Formlabs: 
 Do you want to change how the world creates? 
 At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before. 
 We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us. 
 Your Impact:  
 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated  Associate , Performance Marketing who will play a crucial role in driving our global paid acquisition strategies. You are a hands-on performance marketer to own paid media in the Google ecosystem (Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display). You'll run campaigns day-to-day, manage budgets, and make the spend work harder. This is an IC role for someone who's equal parts strategic and operational, and who lets data drive the decisions. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 
 Run and optimize paid campaigns across Google (Search, Shopping, YouTube, Display) 
 Own channel budgets and forecasts; manage to CAC, ROAS, and efficiency targets 
 Allocate spend across markets, channels, and audiences to balance growth and efficiency 
 Work with Analytics on measurement, incrementally, and attribution—and turn the results into action 
 Constantly test new hypotheses, tactics, and partnerships that unlock scalable growth. 
 
 About You: 
 
 0-2 years in performance/growth marketing with a track record of measurable results managing large budgets 
 Deep hands-on experience managing paid media budgets in Google shopping Ads. 
 Strong analytical chops—you use data to decide, measure, and prioritize. 
 Comfort building forecasts, managing budgets, and explaining business impact to senior stakeholders. 
 Solid grasp of attribution, experimentation, and conversion optimization. 
 Thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments with a high degree of ownership. 
 Use AI tools fluently in your daily work, held to the same quality bar as your own. 
 
 Our Benefits & Perks: 
 
 Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact.  Our People: 
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging.  Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology.  6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.  
 Our Mission:   
 6sense is on a mission to revolutionize how B2B organizations create revenue by predicting customers most likely to buy and recommending the best course of action to engage anonymous buying teams. 6sense Revenue AI is the only sales and marketing platform to unlock the ability to create, manage and convert high-quality pipeline to revenue.   
 Our People: 
 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Accountability, Growth Mindset, Integrity, Fun and One Team.  We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.   
 
 The Role:  
 We are looking for high-energy, driven professionals with sound business acumen, strong technical aptitude and natural sales instincts to join our Sales organization as a Business Development Representative. Your purpose will be to uncover and qualify new opportunities across our target market.  You'll be measured on your ability to create Opportunities that lead to new business.  Ideal candidates should be eager to advance their career by demonstrating their ability to be tenacious self-starters every day. 
 As a Business Development Representative on the Strategic team at 6sense, you’ll be an instrumental player to our growth as we build upon the success we’ve had delivering predictions for enterprises like Cisco, Lenovo, BlueJeans, and Xactly. We will trust you to evangelize 6sense, open doors into opportunities, and consistently exceed targets.  This is not your average start-up; you’ll be going after large deals. 
 What's in it for You: 
 
 The opportunity to generate new business opportunities to fuel our growth 
 Create and prioritize strategic target account lists within a defined territory 
 Research and build accounts (i.e. adding contacts, sending emails, strategic calling) 
 Conduct high level conversations with senior executives in prospect accounts 
 Achieve monthly quotas of qualified opportunities and closed business 
 Solid Base Salary + Commission 
 
 Your traits: 
 
 Intrinsic drive to be successful, love to win – You’ll take initiative to figure it out, do your absolute best work 
 Clear, succinct communicator – Using your customer’s language, you’ll help them clearly understand the value 6sense delivers 
 Innately curious – You’ll know your buyer, their business, and what 6sense means to their success 
 Collaborate and win as a team – You’ll compete, but above that you’ll collaborate, you’ll share what is working, you’ll help the team win, you’ll take on projects outside of closing deals.

 Must be able to come into the Madison office at least 3 days/week. 
 Understanding of B2B Enterprise Marketing & Sales 
 Inside sales experience a plus 
 Enterprise prospecting experience a plus 
 Excellent written/verbal communication skills 
 Strong problem solving skills 
 Motivation, drive and a self-starting attitude 
 Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment 
 Ability to understand customer needs and meet that need with a successful product sale 
 Good time management with strong organizational skills

 Bachelor's degree from an accredited University is strongly preferred

jobs.excerpt:
The Worldwide Grocery Private Brands team is looking for a Product Quality Manager who is passionate about ensuring our products meet or exceed customer expectations. You will join a dynamic, fast-paced, collaborative work environment where you will help build and scale our business across physical stores and online channels in North America. This role ensures that products are consistently produced and meet our quality expectations. You will drive activities across several stakeholder teams including Product Development, Category Managers, Food Safety, Marketing, Supply Chain, Operations, and suppliers to ensure the maintenance of quality expectations for our food and other CPG items. The position focuses on monitoring product performance of launched products, managing trend analysis, customer complaint issue identification, and facilitating product and process improvement initiatives with suppliers and internal cross-functional teams. This is a hands-on role that combines product quality management with laboratory work. In addition to driving quality programs, you will conduct and oversee quality assurance testing, including first production testing, shelf-life verification, and consumer complaint investigations, while maintaining accurate documentation, laboratory equipment, and retention sample inventory. You will also leverage data and mechanisms to identify defects, track quality performance, and drive improvements that maintain customer trust in our brands and products. The right person for this role must be customer obsessed and enjoy using data and mechanisms to drive improvements. The successful candidate will be self-motivated, comfortable working with data and identifying trends from large data sets, have high attention to detail, a strong vision for quality standards and programs, and the ability to develop sound recommendations for product and process improvements. This candidate must be able to build and maintain strong working relationships across teams, earn trust and influence others, be solution oriented, have solid problem-solving skills, communicate clearly (verbal and written) with technical and non-technical teams alike, and be motivated by a fast-paced dynamic environment. Key job responsibilities - Support a robust product quality program across both pre-launch and post-launch initiatives. - Conduct and oversee laboratory quality testing, including first production testing, shelf-life verification, and consumer complaint investigations; execute testing protocols and document results accurately in designated quality data management systems, adhering to standard operating procedures and safety protocols. - Maintain laboratory equipment, perform calibration, and manage retention sample inventory and storage monitoring. - Support the Quality Surveillance program to monitor product performance post-launch, analyzing large sets of customer feedback data (ratings, concessions, complaints) to identify product, process, and supplier improvement opportunities and drive improvement initiatives. - Support business selection health assessments, influencing cross-functional teams based on quality performance metrics to drive remediation, reformulation, or product discontinuation decisions. - Use and help optimize quality dashboards and reporting mechanisms to track program, product, and supplier performance metrics. A day in the life No two days look exactly alike in this role, but most blend hands-on lab work with product quality program management. You might start your morning in the laboratory, running first-production or shelf-life testing on newly launched items and documenting results in our quality systems, then shift to reviewing customer feedback trends (ratings, concessions, and complaints) to spot emerging quality issues. Throughout the week, you will partner closely with a product category, supporting the product quality development of new items from early formulation through launch, helping ensure quality requirements are built in from the start. By midday, you could be working with Product Development, Food Safety, or a supplier on a defect investigation or a business selection health assessment, translating what the data and the bench tell you into concrete remediation or reformulation recommendations. Afternoons often involve maintaining lab equipment and retention samples, refining a quality dashboard, or preparing performance metrics to influence cross-functional decisions. Throughout, you will balance the precision of laboratory testing with the bigger-picture work of keeping our food and other CPG items meeting the quality standards our customers expect. About the team Our team is dedicated to identifying and mitigating WWGS PB product quality risks that protect Amazon's customers, partners, and operations. We work collaboratively across the organization to build and refine the processes, controls, and mechanisms that keep our business compliant and resilient. We value curiosity, clear communication, and a commitment to continuous improvement. As we look ahead, we are focused on scaling our programs and integrating new tools and approaches to stay ahead of emerging challenges. Joining our team means contributing to work that has a direct, meaningful impact on trust and quality at Amazon.

Basic qualifications:
- Experience in the Quality Assurance/testing domain - Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis - Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time - Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities - 2+ years of experience in product or program management, product development, or quality management of food and other CPG items. - Hands-on experience with laboratory equipment and food testing methodologies (physical, chemical, or microbiological). - Experience with laboratory equipment maintenance and calibration, and retention sample inventory management. - Strong analytical skills, including the ability to distill, synthesize, and draw conclusions from large amounts of data. - Experience in analyzing customer feedback data and trend analysis. - Excellent communicator (written, oral, presentation), comfortable communicating with technical and non-technical team members. - Proven track record for cultivating strong relationships with key internal and external partners. - Ability to drive decisions under time pressure without compromising safety or compliance of products. - 2+ years of experience using Microsoft Excel. - Bachelor's degree or above

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams - Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Biology, or a related field. - Knowledge of HACCP and food safety systems. - Food manufacturing quality assurance experience, site operations, or site quality controls. - Familiarity with food industry regulations, standards, and quality management systems. - Experience with Private Brands or consumer goods manufacturing, preferably in regulated spaces. - Experience leveraging AI tools, including validating quality of output. - Diversified experience with the entire product lifecycle and supply chain (R&D, scale-up, material sourcing, operations management, customer feedback). - Experience with continuous improvement programs and procedures. - Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence, or experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. About Vercel: 
 Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next. 
 For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. 
 Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents. 
 We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like  OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next. About the Role: 
 Vercel is seeking a Business Development Representative to help bring the next wave of innovative companies onto the Vercel platform. This role is ideal for individuals who are curious about web technologies and eager to launch their career in technical sales at one of the world’s leading developer tools companies. 
 As a Business Development Representative, you’ll play a key role in connecting with engineering and product leaders at fast-growing companies, educating them on how Vercel can help their teams ship faster and build better web experiences. You’ll work closely with Account Executives to identify, qualify, and nurture opportunities within the Majors segment — our largest enterprise customers. 
 This is a hands-on, high-impact role where you’ll learn directly from world-class sales and product leaders, gain exposure to the SaaS sales cycle, and build a strong foundation for a career in go-to-market at Vercel. 
 What You Will Do: 
 
 Identify and engage enterprise companies that could benefit from Vercel’s platform 
 Research prospects and tailor outreach to engineering and product leaders 
 Qualify inbound leads and generate outbound opportunities through personalized outreach 
 Partner with Account Executives to build pipeline and drive adoption in the Majors segment 
 Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to refine messaging and improve outreach effectiveness 
 
 About You: 
 
 Passion for web development and staying current with the latest trends and technologies 
 2+ years of experience as an outbound SDR 
 Ability to navigate and prospect into large org structures in the Fortune 500 
 Excellent communication skills — ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
 Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail 
 Self-motivated and able to work independently while also collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams 
 
 Bonus If You Have Experience With: 
 
 Background in computer science, web development, or a related technical field 
 Vercel, Next.js, or any other technical background or understanding 
 Salesforce, Outreach, or similar 
 
 Benefits: 
 
 Competitive compensation package, including equity. 
 Inclusive Healthcare Package. 
 Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills. 
 Flexible Time Off. 
 We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed. 
 
 The San Francisco, CA OTE pay range for this role is $100,000 - $120,000 OTE. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.  
 Vercel is committed to fostering and empowering an inclusive community within our organization. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About The Role  
 Hightouch is looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our founding Ad-Studio team to help build the outbound motion for Hightouch's creative platform for building, editing, and launching on-brand ads at the volume performance marketing requires. You'll be a key player in helping stand up a brand-new product motion; there's no established playbook here, so you'll be working directly with leadership to build the foundational processes, messaging, and strategies as we go. You will be outbounding to performance marketers, creative and brand teams, so we are looking for someone who is highly intelligent, comfortable with ambiguity, and able to connect with multiple audiences. 
 What You’ll Do  
 
 Outreach directly into prospective customers who fit our ideal persona (performance marketing, growth, creative, and marketing ops leaders) via cold calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns, and other methods 
 Work with the growth team to research and craft personalized outreach to target accounts, tying messaging to real creative and campaign pain points (creative fatigue, slow production cycles, brand consistency at scale) 
 Find creative methods, channels, and strategies to help guide prospects to a Hightouch Ad Studio demo 
 Own building the outbound playbook from the ground up, you will help shape process, messaging, tooling, and strategy for this new product rather than inherit them 
 You will be tasked with a goal and expected to execute against it on a monthly basis 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Bachelor's degree 
 Self-starter, ability to self-motivate and build from zero in a high-growth start-up 
 Comfort operating without an established playbook and helping create one 
 Effective communication skills, both written and verbal 
 Prior experience (1+ years) engaging customers and prospects 
 Interest in tech, and ideally in marketing, advertising, or data 
 Ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize work 
 
 Even if your experience does not line up perfectly, we are still excited to have you apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description. 
 
 Compensation Details 
 On-Target Earnings: $100,000 annually Base Salary: $70,000 annually OTE is one component of Hightouch's competitive total rewards package and is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation. 

 E-Verify Statement 
 Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Brand Marketing & Creative
jobs.excerpt:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination.

ABOUT THE ROLE

If you're a brand marketing & creative project manager who thrives in fast-moving environments and knows how to balance artistic ambition with operational excellence, this is the role for you. As the Integrated Project Manager, Brand Marketing & Creative at Suno, you'll be the operational heartbeat of the Brand & Creative team - owning end-to-end project management across two connected pillars: brand marketing campaigns and creative studio production. You'll be the connective tissue between ideas and execution, making sure every campaign and every asset - from copy to motion to video to print - gets made on time, to spec, and without anything falling through the cracks. Reporting to the Senior Project Manager & Operations Lead, you'll work closely with internal teams and external partners alike, and play a direct role in helping a world-class creative team do its best work.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/RheZlTv8blpBmZep

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Creative Studio Production Management

 - Own creative intake and trafficking for the creative studio - managing the full pipeline of deliverables (copy, design, motion, video, print) from brief to final delivery supporting all cross-functional teams and needs

 - Drive project management end-to-end across all creative studio asset types, building production timelines and tracking progress to keep the team's output on schedule and on spec

 - Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, and freelancers supporting creative studio production - managing relationships, scopes, and deliverables to keep external work running smoothly

Brand Marketing Campaign Management

 - Own end-to-end project management of brand marketing campaigns spanning tentpole brand moments, social and editorial/content initiatives - working closely with stakeholders across creative, music, press, influencer, product etc - from initial brief through launch and wrap-up

 - Build and maintain campaign timelines and workstreams, tracking milestones across teams and proactively surfacing blockers before they become problems

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for campaign intake, coordinating prioritization and workflow across cross-functional partners including creative, music, editorial, social, product and more

Cross-Team Operations

 - Own stakeholder communication across the org - keeping teams informed, aligned, and unblocked with clear, timely updates on both brand campaign and creative studio status

 - Partner directly with the Sr. PM & Operations Lead to support day-to-day operations of the Brand & Creative team, helping build a team where creative ambition and operational rigor reinforce each other

 - Contribute to Suno's mission of making the world more musical and supporting the creative infrastructure that helps the world's most advanced music platform tell its story

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

Must-Haves

 - 3-5 years of experience in creative and/or campaign project management, either in-house at a creative or brand team or at a creative/marketing agency

 - Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously - both marketing campaigns and creative production - across diverse asset types (copy, design, motion, video, print) without losing detail or momentum

 - Fluency in Notion or a comparable project management tool (Asana, Monday.com http://Monday.com, etc.)

 - Exceptional communication skills - you write clearly, follow up consistently, and know how to move a room without stepping on toes

 - Obsessively organized and detail-oriented - you find satisfaction in structure and nothing slips past you

 - Experience coordinating with external vendors, freelancers, or agencies

 - Genuine curiosity about AI and how it's changing creative work

Nice-to-Haves

 - Background in music, entertainment, or creative media

PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

COMPENSATION

 - $120,000 - $150,000 base salary (before equity)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.excerpt:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. 
 At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. Overview The GTM Compensation Leader owns the end-to-end strategy, design, and operations of sales compensation across the GTM organization. This role is the connective layer between RevOps, Finance, and Field leadership — translating business strategy into comp plans that drive the right behaviors, scale with the business, and hold up to audit and compliance scrutiny. You will lead a comp team, own the ICM/SPM platform, and be the primary voice on plan design, exception handling, and comp operations. 
 Core Responsibilities 
 Comp Plan Design & Strategy   
 
 Own the design of sales compensation plans across segments (Sales, CS/RA, SDR, Partnership, Solution Engineers and otherwhere applicable) — quota, accelerators, SPIFFs, and plan mechanics. 
 Translate GTM strategy (new logo, expansion, retention, Healthy ARR) into comp incentives that drive the intended rep behavior. 
 Partner with RevOps, GTM Leadership, and Finance to align comp design to business priorities each planning cycle. 
 
 Comp Operations & Exception Handling 
 
 Own end-to-end comp operations: crediting, calculations, payout accuracy, and dispute resolution. 
 Build scalable exception-handling logic and governance so one-off requests don't erode plan integrity. 
 Ensure timely, accurate payout cycles with clear audit trails. 
 
 ICM / SPM Platform Ownership :  
 
 Serve as the business owner for the ICM/SPM tool (e.g., Varicent, Everstage) — configuration, roadmap, and vendor relationship. 
 Lead or oversee implementation, migration, or optimization of the platform as the comp motion scales. 
 Ensure the platform reflects current plan logic with minimal manual workaround. 
 
 Compliance & Finance Partnership 
 
 Partner with Finance/Accounting to ensure comp expense recognition is compliant with ASC 606. 
 Own documentation and controls needed to support audit, SOX, and quarter/year-end close. 
 Ensure comp plan changes are properly evaluated for accounting and compliance impact before rollout. 
 
 Team Leadership 
 
 Lead and develop a sales compensation team; build a scalable operating model as headcount and plan complexity grow. 
 Set the bar for accuracy, responsiveness, and trust between the comp function and the field. 
 
 Change Management & Communication 
 
 Own communication and rollout of plan changes — clear, simple, and well-timed to the field. 
 Build feedback loops with field leadership to catch design issues early. 
 
 Scalable Systems & Governance 
 
 Build governance models (approval flows, exception thresholds, plan documentation standards) that scale without adding headcount. 
 Maintain a single source of truth for plan documents, rates, and quotas. 
 
 Key Qualifications

jobs.title: Product Manager, Marketing Orchestration
jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About the Product Team 
 You’ll join a lean, world-class Product Team. We’ve thought deeply about what winning product culture looks like in competitive markets being reshaped by AI. The team prizes founder-level commercial instinct, the bandwidth to cover broad areas, and extremely fast iteration aided by product-minded engineers and AI. We’re the team that invented Reverse ETL, pioneered the Composable architecture, landed AI Decisioning as a category, and most recently invented Agentic Marketing. 
 Why this role matters 
 This portfolio is the majority of Hightouch's revenue — and it deserves a single, dedicated owner. Audiences, traits, experiments, analytics, and orchestration are the surfaces our customers live in every day, but the unifying vision across them has so far been carried by founders and shared across the team. We're hiring this role to change that: one person accountable for the health, direction, and growth of our core. 
 What you’ll own 
 We're looking for a product leader for the core surface area of Hightouch: the interfaces marketers live in every day and the largest driver of our revenue. You'll own a broad portfolio spanning: 
 
 Audiences — the segmentation and targeting experience at the center of Hightouch 
 Charts & Dashboards — analytics surfaces for customers to uncover audience insights and monitor performance 
 Experiments — automation and measurement tools to run & monitor cross-channel experiments 
 Trait Building — no-code interfaces to build custom business logic and data attributes to power marketing campaigns 
 Orchestration — primitives for how campaigns and journeys are sequenced and coordinated globally across all of Hightouch 
 
 We need someone who can drive clarity, set prioritization, and bring a unifying vision across that entire portfolio. 
 What you’ll do 
 The role’s mandate spans multiple modes of product work: from 0-1 innovation to deepening established surfaces to scaling emerging areas. A significant part of the job will be deciding what to prioritize and what outcomes to achieve in which order to hit our company revenue goals. Some examples include: 
 
 Building 0→1 in global orchestration: defining the right audience, campaign and journey primitives for AI-native, Fortune 100-class marketing programs 
 Expanding audience targeting & syncing to better support advanced use cases like couponing and live auctions 
 Transforming our investment in charts, dashboards, and experimentation to better interface with Hightouch Agentic Marketing 
 
 This is a senior, hands-on role — think “product GM.” You'll be fully accountable for both product adoption and go-to-market success, leading across multiple Engineering and Design workstreams. You'll present frequently to customers, work directly with executives, and shape company strategy. 
 About You 
 
 Customer Obsession: You are a relentless customer champion. Your superpower is the ability to forge deep connections, intuitively anticipating needs before customers can even articulate them. 
 Technical Aptitude: More than just understanding technical concepts, you're a translator who turns complex engineering challenges into elegant, accessible solutions. You speak both engineer and business fluently. 
 Strong Communicator: You can drive clarity and distill complex ideas into compelling narratives that inspire teams and resonate with users, turning insights into action. 
 Hunger and Speed: Speed isn't just a preference for you—it's a way of life. You thrive in a high-energy environment where rapid iteration and bold moves are the default, not the exception. 
 Outcome Mindset: You're not a feature factory—you're a strategic mastermind who reverse-engineers success. Every decision you make is laser-focused on driving measurable business impact, turning product vision into tangible results. 
 
 Interview Process 
 
 Hiring Manager Interview [30m]: Chat with Hiring Manager about past experiences and interests to assess role and company fit. 
 Technical & UX Interview [90m]: Live conversation with a Product Manager covering the technical architecture and user experience of a potential feature inside Hightouch. 
 Case Study Interview: Part 1 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (1st part), focusing on problem space discovery and GTM validation. 
 Case Study Interview: Part 2 [45m]: Presentation of the take-home case study (2nd part), focusing on solution mapping and MVP scope. 
 
 We are looking for talented, intellectually curious, and motivated individuals who are interested in tackling the problems above. This is a senior role, but we focus on impact and potential for growth more than years of experience. The salary range for this position is $240,000 - $320,000 USD per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window. E-Verify Statement 
 Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.excerpt:
Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.  That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it. We sell a powerful, flexible product to organizations with very different problems, teams, and ways of working. That means the best opportunities rarely come from following a script. We need someone who finds that energizing—someone curious enough to understand how a business works, persistent enough to earn a prospect’s attention, and thoughtful enough to make every interaction relevant. 
 If you’re excited by the challenge of finding the right accounts, understanding what matters to them, and figuring out how to earn a conversation, you’ll thrive here. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, learn quickly from what works and what doesn’t, and build the skills to become an exceptional salesperson. 
 Please note, this is a hybrid position based in Austin with the expectation of 3 days a week in office. 
 What you'll do 
 
 Run a hybrid pipeline motion: act on product-led signals early in the week, then shift into outbound prospecting for the bulk of your time. 
 Qualify prospects through calls, emails, and social media (LinkedIn) to generate sales-ready meetings for Account Executives. 
 Partner with AEs on our larger, more strategic accounts, shaping territory plans and outreach. 
 Build, test, and iterate on outbound strategies, using AI tools to work faster without losing quality. 
 Show up for a structured weekly coaching rhythm: pipeline and messaging review early in the week, skill-building (cold calling, qualification, objection handling) later on. 
 Deeply understand our customers' day-to-day pains so you can speak to them with real credibility. 
 
 Who you are 
 
 You bring the will;we'll teach you the skill. Hardworking, intellectually curious, and coachable matter more to us than pedigree. 
 You have grit and are comfortable with volume and rejection. Outbound requires consistency, and you show up for it every day. 
 You’re a strong written and verbal communicator. You can tell a story that shows you understand a customer’s needs and why Airtable is relevant to them. 
 You're AI-fluent, or eager to get there fast. We use AI tools throughout our sales motion, and you’re excited to learn how to use them to work smarter and more effectively. 
 
 Airtable is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any characteristic protected by applicable federal and state laws, regulations and ordinances. Learn more about your  EEO rights as an applicant .  
 VEVRAA-Federal Contractor 
 If you have a medical condition, disability, or religious belief/practice which inhibits your ability to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please complete our Accommodations Request Form and let us know how we may assist you. Airtable is committed to participating in the interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. 
 Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills, and experience. 
 Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits, restricted stock units, and may include incentive compensation.   To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out   Life at Airtable . For work locations in Austin, the on-target earning range for this role is: $77,000 — $99,900 USD Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Airtable’s collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here . For applicants that live in or have a link to Australia, please see this Privacy Collection Statement for details regarding Airtable's collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process. 
 Stay Safe from Job Scams: All official Airtable communication will come from an @airtable.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at hr@airtable.com . Learn more about avoiding job scams here .

jobs.title: Business Analyst, Network Strategy and Performance
jobs.excerpt:
Business Analyst in Network Strategy and Performance owns owns processes & analytics that directly shape how Amazon serves customers globally. They are an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. They are self-motivated, operating independently in an autonomous environment to deliver an exceptional customer experience with little to no guidance. They operationalize the long- and short-term staffing plans, working cross-functionally with site Operations, planning teams, training, finance, and others. They will contribute to the team's AI-driven transformation agenda by applying AI tools to increase the speed, quality, and scale of analytical outputs. They do not just report or fix defects, but think critically about why they happen, what surrounds them, and how to prevent them — combining analytical rigor with a proactive, anticipatory mindset. Key job responsibilities - Create and accurately maintain Customer Service Associate (CSA) shift schedules ensuring shifts are optimally planned to meet the sites short term forecast requirements and Service Levels (SL). - Monitor actual staffing levels against planned staffing and take the relevant corrective actions as required improve SL. - Effectively plan and monitor CSA adherence to assigned schedule, including productive and non-productive activities. - Work closely with mid to senior-level leaders across core teams to identify and mitigate emerging risks and assists in creating mitigation plans for staffing corrections and SL recovery. - Responsible for coordinating site-staffing needs including reporting and analysis of site headcount numbers as per staffing plan. - Understanding and monitor symptoms of CSA burnout, detecting the metrics that can signal these symptoms and assist in implementing interventions to eliminate outlier experiences. - Responsible to coordinate various cross-training, new-hires, and management of network and site-wide shift rotation processes as per business need. - Create work schedules for associates, identifies and proactively resolves headcount deficiencies and overages. - Investigate defects and operational anomalies to identify systemic drivers (system-related, behavioral, or shared responsibility), not just symptoms. Highlight and communicate metrics impacting the operation that could impact service levels, customer experience, and business process. - Build and maintain validation checks, dashboards, and automated alerts to catch defects early — before they impact customers or operations. - Independently apply AI tools (e.g., Amazon Q, generative AI assistants, AgentZ) to accelerate analytical workflows, identifying opportunities to improve speed and quality of outputs. - Apply AI tools to develop automation for repetitive tasks within your workstream, demonstrating measurable productivity improvement. About the team The Network Strategy and Performance (NP) team defines and delivers the right human-assisted support to Amazon customers under demand and labor supply volatility, by optimizing the Amazon Customer Service (CS) network for customer experience, associate experience, and cost. We are responsible for: (1) planning customer support staffing; (2) preserving the customer experience when customers contact Customer Service; and (3) ensuring best costs for providing customer support. We analyse historical data and anticipate potential business events to accurately predict the number of Customer Service Associates (CSAs) required for a given period. Our areas of expertise span forecasting, planning, optimization, data analytics, and reporting. We deliver our vision using operations research, data science, and program management — and we continue to challenge the status quo, invent and simplify, and deliver excellence for our customers. The Network Performance team is on a transformation journey. We are building a future-ready team that combines analytical rigor with AI fluency, executive-level communication, and the ability to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries. We are seeking a Business Analyst to join this team and help shape how Amazon plans, staff, and optimizes its Customer Service network. 

Basic qualifications:
- 2+ years of program or project management experience - 1+ years of supply chain experience

Preferred qualifications:
- Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology - Experience in MS Access and SQL - Experience in requirement gathering and ability to write clear and detailed requirement document Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner. The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits . USA, WA, Seattle - 80,200.00 - 100,600.00 USD annually

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (East)
jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About The Role  
 Hightouch is looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for generating top of the funnel leads in addition to building foundational processes and strategies to the commercial sales team. You will be outbounding to engineers, marketers, and operation teams so we are looking for someone who is highly intelligent and also has the ability to connect with multiple audiences. 
 What You’ll Do  
 
 Outreach directly into prospective agents that fit our ideal persona via cold-calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns and other methods 
 You work with the growth team to  research and craft personalized outreach to target accounts 
 Find creative methods, channels, and strategies to help guide prospects to our free trial 
 As part of our growing SDR team, help define and improve sales processes, strategies, tactics, and more 
 You will be tasked with a goal and expected to execute against it on a monthly basis 
 You will live in slack and monitor for new signups, engaging them directly in order to schedule meetings with them. Those meetings will be scheduled for with the sales org and the customer 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Bachelor's degree 
 Be a Self-starter, ability to self-motivate in a high-growth start-up 
 Effective communication skills, both written and verbal 
 Prior experience engaging customers and prospects 
 Interest in tech and more specifically data 
 Ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize work 
 
 Even if your experience does not line up perfectly, we are still excited to have you apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description. 
 
 Compensation Details 
 The salary range for this position is: 
 On-Target Earnings: $100,000 annually Base Salary: $70,000 annually This is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation. 
 E-Verify Statement 
 Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants. 
 E-Verify Notice E-Verify Notice (Spanish) Right to Work Notice Right to Work Notice (Spanish)

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (West)
jobs.excerpt:
About Hightouch 
 Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works. 
 Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible. 
 Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart. 
 At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you. About The Role  
 Hightouch is looking for a Sales Development Representative to join our rapidly growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for generating top of the funnel leads in addition to building foundational processes and strategies to the commercial sales team. You will be outbounding to engineers, marketers, and operation teams so we are looking for someone who is highly intelligent and also has the ability to connect with multiple audiences. 
 What You’ll Do  
 
 Outreach directly into prospective agents that fit our ideal persona via cold-calls, text, emails, integrated marketing campaigns, LinkedIn campaigns and other methods 
 You work with the growth team to  research and craft personalized outreach to target accounts 
 Find creative methods, channels, and strategies to help guide prospects to our free trial 
 As part of our growing SDR team, help define and improve sales processes, strategies, tactics, and more 
 You will be tasked with a goal and expected to execute against it on a monthly basis 
 You will live in slack and monitor for new signups, engaging them directly in order to schedule meetings with them. Those meetings will be scheduled for with the sales org and the customer 
 
 What We're Looking For 
 
 Bachelor's degree 
 Be a Self-starter, ability to self-motivate in a high-growth start-up 
 Effective communication skills, both written and verbal 
 Prior experience engaging customers and prospects 
 Interest in tech and more specifically data 
 Ability to multitask, organize, and prioritize work 
 
 Even if your experience does not line up perfectly, we are still excited to have you apply. The best hires do not always check off every box of a job description. 
 
 Compensation Details 
 The salary range for this position is: 
 On-Target Earnings: $100,000 annually Base Salary: $70,000 annually This is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation. 

 E-Verify Statement 
 Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants. 
 E-Verify Notice E-Verify Notice (Spanish) Right to Work Notice Right to Work Notice (Spanish)

resume_core.label: Hightouch — Sales Development Representative (West)
resume_core.summary: Product Marketing Manager with 6+ years across enterprise B2B SaaS, fintech, and AI platforms, and an MBA in Business Analytics and Machine Learning. Proven track record of developing positioning, messaging, go-to-market launches, and sales enablement for technical products sold to enterprise buyers. Skilled at translating complex technology into customer stories and executive-level narratives, and at using performance data to refine what works.

experience.title: MBA Intern, Product Marketing & Sales
highlights: Led 40+ discovery conversations with C-suite prospects as the first commercial hire, defining customer profiles and use cases that shaped content and product roadmaps.
Wrote targeted outbound messaging frameworks and localized content, lifting outbound engagement rates to 25%+.
Built SQL and Tableau dashboards to identify lead-to-demo funnel friction and inform segmentation, contributing to a 30% improvement in lead-to-demo conversion.
Designed a stage-based user-activation roadmap with triggered email sequences and ran sequence tests to improve activation.

experience.title: Marketing & Analytics Specialist
highlights: Owned solution-track campaigns end to end by product line and region across 50+ countries (LinkedIn sponsored content, Eloqua email), including campaign design, metrics, and guardrails; increased marketing-qualified leads 28%.
Equipped 50+ account executives with messaging playbooks, first-call decks, and competitive talking points, reducing campaign execution timelines by 15%.

Partnered with account-based marketing teams on campaigns targeting named banks across North America and the Middle East; developed account-specific messaging and reviewed all campaign content for product accuracy.
Developed customer success stories for banking clients, coordinating stakeholder and legal approvals before publishing them and repurposing them into social and email content.
Planned and ran Finacle Day, the annual flagship customer event with 5,000+ attendees, end to end, alongside executive roundtables and customer briefings with bank leadership.
Increased content engagement 2.4x using SQL and Tableau to evaluate campaign performance and guide content optimization, including email tests across banners, length, CTA, and form length.

experience.title: Lead Consultant, Product Marketing
highlights: Owned positioning, messaging, and executive narratives for ZIF, an AI-driven IT operations (AIOps) platform, translating technical capabilities into customer use cases and business value.
Delivered 80+ live product demonstrations and led CXO discovery calls as first client touch, influencing software procurement decisions globally.
Coordinated cross-functional product launches with Product and Engineering, defining positioning, messaging, and launch plans.
Directed product benchmarking studies against AIOps alternatives, producing competitive talking points for sales and positioning inputs for product.
Rebuilt the product website and authored technical content (blogs, solution briefs, presentations), growing website engagement 40%.
Wrote customer success stories and case studies for healthcare enterprise clients, turning implementation outcomes into proof points for sales and campaigns.

experience.title: Marketing Manager
highlights: Grew digital acquisition footprint 200% and secured 50M+ impressions through integrated, multi-channel campaigns.
Generated ~$35K USD through online fundraising campaigns using structured conversion optimization across funnels.
Unified frameworks across marketing, legal, and finance to ensure compliance and streamlined execution.
